- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### NetworkingSite

A site where VPCs and Reserved IPs can be created.

- `site_id` (string, required) — Canonical opaque site identifier accepted by VPC and Reserved IP creation. Copy it exactly; do not substitute a region or site name.
- `site_name` (string, required) — Display name of the site.
- `available` (boolean, required) — Whether the site currently accepts new VPCs and reservations.
- `message` (string, optional, nullable) — Why the site is unavailable, when it is.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

# List VPCs

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs

Lists VPCs in the selected workspace. Requires scope: network.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/list-vpcs

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.
- `site_id` (string, optional) — Optional exact site filter. Copy `site_id` from `GET /networking/sites`.

## Response

### 200

VPCs returned successfully.

- `list of VpcSummary`

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### VpcSummary

A VPC with its attached-node count and NAT gateway pricing.

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the VPC.
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the VPC lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the VPC.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the VPC.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `connectivity_type` (enum, required) — The VPC's internet model. - `public`: instances may have dedicated public IPs. - `nat_gateway`: private VPC with managed outbound NAT; dedicated public IPs are not allowed. - `private`: no managed internet path.
  - Allowed values: `public`, `private`, `nat_gateway`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `account_id` (string, optional) — Legacy alias of `organization_id`.
- `description` (string, optional) — Description of the VPC.
- `region` (string, optional, nullable) — Region label stored with the VPC, when set.
- `is_default` (boolean, optional) — Whether this is the workspace's default VPC.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.
- `node_count` (integer, optional) — Number of VMs attached to the VPC.
- `nat_pricing` (NatPricing, optional) — Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

### NatPricing

Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.

- `currency` (string, optional, default: USD) — ISO 4217 code of the currency the prices are in.
- `price_per_hour` (double, optional, default: 0) — Hourly charge for the gateway.
- `data_price_per_gb` (double, optional, default: 0) — Charge per GB of data processed.
- `billing_enforced` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Whether these charges are being applied.

# Create a VPC

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs
Content-Type: application/json

Creates an isolated virtual network. Requires scope: network.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "<name>", "site_id": "68b99bd78a8eda32ff3f16ea"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/create-vpc

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a CreateVpcRequest.

- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the VPC.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Required network placement site. Copy `site_id` from `GET /networking/sites` and choose an entry where `available` is `true`. Do not use a region name.
- `description` (string, optional, default: ) — Optional description.
- `region` (string, optional, nullable) — Optional region label stored with the VPC.
- `cidr` (string, optional, nullable) — RFC1918 IPv4 CIDR with a prefix between /22 and /28.
- `auto_cidr` (boolean, optional, default: true) — Let the service choose a free CIDR when `cidr` is omitted. Default true.
- `create_default_subnet` (boolean, optional, default: true) — Create a first subnet together with the VPC. Default true.
- `default_subnet_cidr` (string, optional, nullable) — CIDR for that first subnet; chosen automatically when omitted.
- `is_default` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Mark the VPC as the workspace's default VPC. Default false.
- `connectivity_type` (enum, optional, default: public) — The VPC's internet model; the server uses `public` when this is omitted. `public` keeps dedicated public IPs available to its VMs. `private` has no shared public edge, but a VM can still be given a Reserved IP. `nat_gateway` is a private VPC with managed outbound NAT and refuses dedicated public IPs.
  - Allowed values: `public`, `private`, `nat_gateway`

## Response

### 201

VPC created successfully.

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the VPC.
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the VPC lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the VPC.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the VPC.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `connectivity_type` (enum, required) — The VPC's internet model. - `public`: instances may have dedicated public IPs. - `nat_gateway`: private VPC with managed outbound NAT; dedicated public IPs are not allowed. - `private`: no managed internet path.
  - Allowed values: `public`, `private`, `nat_gateway`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `account_id` (string, optional) — Legacy alias of `organization_id`.
- `description` (string, optional) — Description of the VPC.
- `region` (string, optional, nullable) — Region label stored with the VPC, when set.
- `is_default` (boolean, optional) — Whether this is the workspace's default VPC.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.
- `node_count` (integer, optional) — Number of VMs attached to the VPC.
- `nat_pricing` (NatPricing, optional) — Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.
- `subnets` (list of Subnet, optional) — Subnets in the VPC.
- `nat_gateways` (list of NatGateway, optional) — NAT gateways in the VPC.
- `attached_nodes` (list of VpcAttachedNode, optional) — VMs attached to the VPC.

## Errors

From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 409 Conflict Error

The request conflicts with the current resource state.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 423 Locked Error

The organization is suspended (`organization_suspended`), so writes are refused.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### NatPricing

Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.

- `currency` (string, optional, default: USD) — ISO 4217 code of the currency the prices are in.
- `price_per_hour` (double, optional, default: 0) — Hourly charge for the gateway.
- `data_price_per_gb` (double, optional, default: 0) — Charge per GB of data processed.
- `billing_enforced` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Whether these charges are being applied.

### Subnet

A subnet of a VPC.

- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the subnet belongs to.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the subnet lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the subnet.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the subnet.
- `gateway` (string, required) — Gateway IPv4 address of the subnet.
- `dns` (list of string, required) — DNS resolvers handed to instances in the subnet.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

### NatGateway

A managed NAT gateway that gives a VPC's VMs outbound internet access through one public address.

- `nat_gateway_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the gateway.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the gateway serves.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the gateway lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the gateway.
- `public_ip_id` (string, required) — ID of the public IP the gateway uses.
- `public_ip` (string, required) — Public IPv4 address of the gateway.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `subnet_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Subnet the gateway is placed in.
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `pricing` (NatPricing, optional) — Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

### VpcAttachedNode

Summary of a VM attached to a VPC.

- `allocation_id` (string, optional) — ID of the attachment.
- `vm_id` (string, optional) — ID of the attached VM.
- `subnet_id` (string, optional) — Subnet the VM is attached to.
- `private_ip` (string, optional) — Private IPv4 address assigned to the VM.
- `connectivity` (enum, optional) — How the VM reaches the internet from this subnet. - `private`: no internet path. - `public_ip`: a Reserved IP is attached to the allocation. - `nat`: outbound traffic goes through the VPC's NAT gateway.
  - Allowed values: `private`, `public_ip`, `nat`
- `public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Reserved IP address attached to the VM, when `connectivity` is `public_ip`.
- `nat_public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Public address of the NAT gateway used, when `connectivity` is `nat`.
- `status` (string, optional) — Attachment state: `reserved`, `attaching`, `attached`, `moving`, `detaching` or `releasing`.
- `attached_at` (datetime, optional) — When the VM was attached (ISO 8601).

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

func main() {

	payload := strings.NewReader("{\n  \"name\": \"<name>\",\n  \"site_id\": \"68b99bd78a8eda32ff3f16ea\"\n}")

	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}

import Foundation

let headers = [
  "Authorization": "Bearer <token>",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"

let parameters = [

  "site_id": "68b99bd78a8eda32ff3f16ea"

  if (error != nil) {

  } else {

    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()

title: Get a VPC

# Get a VPC

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}

Returns a VPC and its subnets, NAT gateways, and attached nodes. Requires scope: network.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VPC_ID: VPC ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/$VPC_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/get-vpc

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

VPC returned successfully.

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the VPC.
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the VPC lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the VPC.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the VPC.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `connectivity_type` (enum, required) — The VPC's internet model. - `public`: instances may have dedicated public IPs. - `nat_gateway`: private VPC with managed outbound NAT; dedicated public IPs are not allowed. - `private`: no managed internet path.
  - Allowed values: `public`, `private`, `nat_gateway`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `account_id` (string, optional) — Legacy alias of `organization_id`.
- `description` (string, optional) — Description of the VPC.
- `region` (string, optional, nullable) — Region label stored with the VPC, when set.
- `is_default` (boolean, optional) — Whether this is the workspace's default VPC.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.
- `node_count` (integer, optional) — Number of VMs attached to the VPC.
- `nat_pricing` (NatPricing, optional) — Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.
- `subnets` (list of Subnet, optional) — Subnets in the VPC.
- `nat_gateways` (list of NatGateway, optional) — NAT gateways in the VPC.
- `attached_nodes` (list of VpcAttachedNode, optional) — VMs attached to the VPC.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. - `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. - `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the subnet.
- `gateway` (string, required) — Gateway IPv4 address of the subnet.
- `dns` (list of string, required) — DNS resolvers handed to instances in the subnet.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

### NatGateway

A managed NAT gateway that gives a VPC's VMs outbound internet access through one public address.

- `nat_gateway_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the gateway.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the gateway serves.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the gateway lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the gateway.
- `public_ip_id` (string, required) — ID of the public IP the gateway uses.
- `public_ip` (string, required) — Public IPv4 address of the gateway.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `subnet_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Subnet the gateway is placed in.
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `pricing` (NatPricing, optional) — Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

### VpcAttachedNode

Summary of a VM attached to a VPC.

- `allocation_id` (string, optional) — ID of the attachment.
- `vm_id` (string, optional) — ID of the attached VM.
- `subnet_id` (string, optional) — Subnet the VM is attached to.
- `private_ip` (string, optional) — Private IPv4 address assigned to the VM.
- `connectivity` (enum, optional) — How the VM reaches the internet from this subnet. - `private`: no internet path. - `public_ip`: a Reserved IP is attached to the allocation. - `nat`: outbound traffic goes through the VPC's NAT gateway.
  - Allowed values: `private`, `public_ip`, `nat`
- `public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Reserved IP address attached to the VM, when `connectivity` is `public_ip`.
- `nat_public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Public address of the NAT gateway used, when `connectivity` is `nat`.
- `status` (string, optional) — Attachment state: `reserved`, `attaching`, `attached`, `moving`, `detaching` or `releasing`.
- `attached_at` (datetime, optional) — When the VM was attached (ISO 8601).

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

# Delete a VPC

DELETE https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}

Deletes an empty VPC. Requires scope: network.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VPC_ID: VPC ID
curl -X DELETE "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/$VPC_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/delete-vpc

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 204

VPC deleted successfully.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 409 Conflict Error

The request conflicts with the current resource state.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 423 Locked Error

The organization is suspended (`organization_suspended`), so writes are refused.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

# Update a VPC

PATCH https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}
Content-Type: application/json

Updates mutable VPC metadata. Requires scope: network.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VPC_ID: VPC ID
curl -X PATCH "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/$VPC_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "<name>", "description": "<description>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/update-vpc

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects an UpdateVpcRequest.

- `name` (string, optional) — New display name.
- `description` (string, optional) — New description.

## Response

### 200

VPC updated successfully.

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the VPC.
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the VPC lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the VPC.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the VPC.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `connectivity_type` (enum, required) — The VPC's internet model. - `public`: instances may have dedicated public IPs. - `nat_gateway`: private VPC with managed outbound NAT; dedicated public IPs are not allowed. - `private`: no managed internet path.
  - Allowed values: `public`, `private`, `nat_gateway`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `account_id` (string, optional) — Legacy alias of `organization_id`.
- `description` (string, optional) — Description of the VPC.
- `region` (string, optional, nullable) — Region label stored with the VPC, when set.
- `is_default` (boolean, optional) — Whether this is the workspace's default VPC.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.
- `node_count` (integer, optional) — Number of VMs attached to the VPC.
- `nat_pricing` (NatPricing, optional) — Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.
- `subnets` (list of Subnet, optional) — Subnets in the VPC.
- `nat_gateways` (list of NatGateway, optional) — NAT gateways in the VPC.
- `attached_nodes` (list of VpcAttachedNode, optional) — VMs attached to the VPC.

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 409 Conflict Error

The request conflicts with the current resource state.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

### 423 Locked Error

The organization is suspended (`organization_suspended`), so writes are refused.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### NatPricing

Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.

- `currency` (string, optional, default: USD) — ISO 4217 code of the currency the prices are in.
- `price_per_hour` (double, optional, default: 0) — Hourly charge for the gateway.
- `data_price_per_gb` (double, optional, default: 0) — Charge per GB of data processed.
- `billing_enforced` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Whether these charges are being applied.

### Subnet

A subnet of a VPC.

- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the subnet belongs to.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the subnet lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the subnet.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the subnet.
- `gateway` (string, required) — Gateway IPv4 address of the subnet.
- `dns` (list of string, required) — DNS resolvers handed to instances in the subnet.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

### NatGateway

A managed NAT gateway that gives a VPC's VMs outbound internet access through one public address.

- `nat_gateway_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the gateway.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the gateway serves.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the gateway lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the gateway.
- `public_ip_id` (string, required) — ID of the public IP the gateway uses.
- `public_ip` (string, required) — Public IPv4 address of the gateway.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `subnet_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Subnet the gateway is placed in.
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `pricing` (NatPricing, optional) — Price of a NAT gateway as recorded when it was created.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

### VpcAttachedNode

Summary of a VM attached to a VPC.

- `allocation_id` (string, optional) — ID of the attachment.
- `vm_id` (string, optional) — ID of the attached VM.
- `subnet_id` (string, optional) — Subnet the VM is attached to.
- `private_ip` (string, optional) — Private IPv4 address assigned to the VM.
- `connectivity` (enum, optional) — How the VM reaches the internet from this subnet. - `private`: no internet path. - `public_ip`: a Reserved IP is attached to the allocation. - `nat`: outbound traffic goes through the VPC's NAT gateway.
  - Allowed values: `private`, `public_ip`, `nat`
- `public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Reserved IP address attached to the VM, when `connectivity` is `public_ip`.
- `nat_public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Public address of the NAT gateway used, when `connectivity` is `nat`.
- `status` (string, optional) — Attachment state: `reserved`, `attaching`, `attached`, `moving`, `detaching` or `releasing`.
- `attached_at` (datetime, optional) — When the VM was attached (ISO 8601).

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"net/http"
	"io"
)

func main() {

	url := "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/vpc_123?workspace_id=710995"

	payload := strings.NewReader("{\n  \"name\": \"<name>\",\n  \"description\": \"<description>\"\n}")

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("PATCH", url, payload)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}

  }
})

# List VPC subnets

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}/subnets

Lists subnets in a VPC. Requires scope: network.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VPC_ID: VPC ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/$VPC_ID/subnets?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/list-vpc-subnets

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Subnets returned successfully.

- `list of Subnet`

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the subnet belongs to.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the subnet lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the subnet.

# Create a VPC subnet

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}/subnets
Content-Type: application/json

Creates a subnet in a VPC. Requires scope: network.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VPC_ID: VPC ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/$VPC_ID/subnets?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "<name>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/create-vpc-subnet

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a CreateSubnetRequest.

- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the subnet.
- `cidr` (string, optional, nullable) — IPv4 CIDR inside the VPC range. Chosen automatically when omitted and `auto_cidr` is true.
- `auto_cidr` (boolean, optional, default: true) — Let the service choose a free CIDR when `cidr` is omitted. Default true.
- `prefix_length` (integer, optional, nullable) — Prefix length to use for an automatically chosen CIDR.
- `dns` (list of string, optional, default: ["1.1.1.1","8.8.8.8"]) — DNS resolvers handed to instances in the subnet. Default `1.1.1.1` and `8.8.8.8`.

## Response

### 201

Subnet created successfully.

- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the subnet belongs to.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the subnet lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the subnet.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the subnet.
- `gateway` (string, required) — Gateway IPv4 address of the subnet.
- `dns` (list of string, required) — DNS resolvers handed to instances in the subnet.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.

# Get a VPC subnet

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}/subnets/{subnet_id}

Returns one subnet in a VPC, including its CIDR range, gateway, and DNS settings. Requires scope: network.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VPC_ID: VPC ID
# SUBNET_ID: Subnet ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/$VPC_ID/subnets/$SUBNET_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/get-vpc-subnet

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC ID.
- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Subnet ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Subnet returned successfully.

- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the subnet belongs to.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the subnet lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the subnet.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the subnet.
- `gateway` (string, required) — Gateway IPv4 address of the subnet.
- `dns` (list of string, required) — DNS resolvers handed to instances in the subnet.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. import Foundation

let headers = ["Authorization": "Bearer <token>"]

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/vpc_123/subnets/subnet_123?workspace_id=710995")! as URL,

  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```

# Delete a VPC subnet

DELETE https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}/subnets/{subnet_id}

Deletes a subnet from a VPC. Requires scope: network.write.

```

# Update a VPC subnet

PATCH https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}/subnets/{subnet_id}
Content-Type: application/json

Renames a VPC subnet or changes its DNS settings. Requires scope: network.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VPC_ID: VPC ID
# SUBNET_ID: Subnet ID
curl -X PATCH "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/$VPC_ID/subnets/$SUBNET_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "<name>", "dns": ["<dns>"]}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/update-vpc-subnet

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC ID.
- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Subnet ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects an UpdateSubnetRequest.

- `name` (string, optional) — New display name.
- `dns` (list of string, optional) — New DNS resolvers handed to instances in the subnet.

## Response

### 200

Subnet updated successfully.

- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the subnet.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the subnet belongs to.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site the subnet lives at.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the subnet.
- `cidr` (string, required) — IPv4 CIDR of the subnet.
- `gateway` (string, required) — Gateway IPv4 address of the subnet.
- `dns` (list of string, required) — DNS resolvers handed to instances in the subnet.
- `status` (enum, required) — Lifecycle status of a VPC, subnet, NAT gateway or port-forwarding rule. - `provisioning`: being created. - `available`: ready for use. - `error`: the last change failed; see `error_message`. - `deleting`: being removed.
  - Allowed values: `provisioning`, `available`, `error`, `deleting`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the resource was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `error_message` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `error`.

- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}

# List nodes attached to a VPC

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/{vpc_id}/nodes

Lists the VMs attached to a VPC. Requires scope: network.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VPC_ID: VPC ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/networking/vpcs/$VPC_ID/nodes?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/vpcs/list-vpc-nodes

## Authentication

### Query parameters

## Response

Attached nodes returned successfully.

## Types

### NetworkAllocation

A VM's attachment to a VPC subnet: its private address and how it reaches the internet.

- `allocation_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the attachment.
- `vpc_id` (string, required) — VPC the VM is attached to.
- `subnet_id` (string, required) — Subnet the VM is attached to.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the attached VM.
- `connectivity` (enum, required) — How the VM reaches the internet from this subnet. - `private`: no internet path. - `public_ip`: a Reserved IP is attached to the allocation. - `nat`: outbound traffic goes through the VPC's NAT gateway.
  - Allowed values: `private`, `public_ip`, `nat`
- `private_ip` (string, required) — Private IPv4 address assigned to the VM.
- `prefix_length` (integer, required) — Prefix length of the subnet.
- `subnet_mask` (string, required) — Subnet mask in dotted-decimal form.
- `gateway` (string, required) — Gateway IPv4 address of the subnet.
- `dns` (list of string, required) — DNS resolvers handed to the VM.
- `status` (string, required) — Attachment state: `reserved`, `attaching`, `attached`, `moving`, `detaching` or `releasing`.
- `public_ip_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Reserved IP attached to the allocation, when `connectivity` is `public_ip`.
- `public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Address of that Reserved IP.
- `nat_gateway_id` (string, optional, nullable) — NAT gateway used, when `connectivity` is `nat`.
- `nat_public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Public address of that NAT gateway.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any
