# List compute images

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/images

Lists ready public OS images compatible with cloud or GPU VMs. Requires scope: vm.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/images?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID&vm_type=cloud" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/compute-catalog/list-compute-images

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.
- `vm_type` (enum, required) — Kind of VM the images are for. Required. - `cloud` - `gpu`
  - Allowed values: `cloud`, `gpu`
- `site_id` (string, optional) — Optional exact placement filter. Copy `site_id` from `GET /compute/sites`.

## Response

### 200

Compute images returned successfully.

- `images` (list of ComputeImage, required) — Images matching the request.
- `count` (integer, required) — Number of items in `images`.
- `vm_type` (enum, required) — Kind of virtual machine. - `cloud`: general-purpose cloud VM. - `gpu`: VM with attached GPUs.
  - Allowed values: `cloud`, `gpu`
- `site_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Site filter that was applied, when one was given.

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### ComputeImage

An OS image (template) that VM creation accepts.

- `template_id` (string, required) — Template ID accepted by VM creation.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the image.
- `os_distro` (string, required) — OS distribution, for example `ubuntu`.
- `os_type` (enum, required) — OS family. - `linux` - `windows`
  - Allowed values: `linux`, `windows`
- `architecture` (string, required) — CPU architecture, for example `x86_64`.
- `size_bytes` (integer, required) — Image size in bytes; 0 when unknown.
- `gpu_compatible` (boolean, required) — Whether the image can be used for GPU VMs.
- `compatible_vm_types` (list of enum, required) — VM types the image can be used with.
  - Allowed values: `cloud`, `gpu`
- `site_ids` (list of string, required) — Sites where the image is available.
- `description` (string, optional, nullable) — Description of the image, when the catalog has one.
- `distro_version` (string, optional, nullable) — Distribution version, for example `22.04`.
- `image_format` (string, optional, nullable) — Disk image format, for example `qcow2`, when known.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

# List cloud VMs

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms

Returns one page of cloud VMs in the workspace, newest first: 10 by default, at most 100 per page. Use `limit` and `offset` to page through the rest. Requires scope: vm.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/list-cloud-vms

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.
- `limit` (integer, optional, default: 10) — Maximum number of records to return. The server returns 10 when this is omitted; use `offset` to read further pages.
- `offset` (integer, optional, default: 0) — Number of records to skip before the first one returned.

## Response

### 200

Cloud VMs returned successfully.

- `list of CloudVm`

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### CloudVm

A cloud VM.

- `id` (string, optional) — Unique VM ID.
- `name` (string, optional) — Display name of the VM.
- `status` (enum, optional) — Lifecycle status of the VM. - `pending`: create accepted, not started yet. - `creating`, `provisioning`: compute, disk and network resources are being allocated. - `configuring`: the guest is being configured (keys, network, cloud-init). - `running`: powered on. - `starting`: a start is in progress. - `stopping`: a stop is in progress. - `stopped`: powered off. - `rebooting`: a reboot is in progress. - `resizing`, `resizing_plan`, `resizing_disk`: a CPU/memory or root-disk change is being applied. - `attaching_volume`, `detaching_volume`: a block volume is being attached or detached. - `deleting`: a delete is in progress. - `deleted`: the VM no longer exists. - `error`: the last operation failed; see the operation or events for detail.
  - Allowed values: `pending`, `creating`, `provisioning`, `configuring`, `running`, `starting`, `stopping`, `stopped`, `rebooting`, `resizing`, `attaching_volume`, `detaching_volume`, `resizing_plan`, `resizing_disk`, `deleting`, `deleted`, `error`
- `cpu` (integer, optional) — vCPUs.
- `ram_mb` (integer, optional) — Memory in MB.
- `disk_gb` (integer, optional) — Root disk size in GB.
- `os_type` (string, optional) — OS family: `linux` or `windows`.
- `os_distro` (string, optional) — OS distribution, for example `ubuntu`.
- `plan_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Name of the compute plan the VM runs on.
- `public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Public IPv4 address; null when the VM has none.
- `private_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Private IPv4 address; null when none is assigned.
- `tags` (list of string, optional) — Tags given at creation.
- `created_at` (datetime, optional) — When the VM was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the VM record was last changed (ISO 8601).

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

```swift
import Foundation

let headers = ["Authorization": "Bearer <token>"]

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms?workspace_id=710995")! as URL,
                                        cachePolicy: .useProtocolCachePolicy,
                                    timeoutInterval: 10.0)
request.httpMethod = "GET"
request.allHTTPHeaderFields = headers

let session = URLSession.shared
let dataTask = session.dataTask(with: request as URLRequest, completionHandler: { (data, response, error) -> Void in
  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```

# Create a cloud VM

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms
Content-Type: application/json

Creates a cloud VM. Returns an operation you can poll for status. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# BILLING_CATALOG: the selected plan's billing_catalog object from GET /compute/plans, passed through unchanged
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "web-server-01", "plan_id": "019f25b7-c1b3-7a9e-bfb9-8c83e323b517", "site_id": "68b99bd78a8eda32ff3f16ea", "template_id": "tmpl_ubuntu_2204", "os_distro": "ubuntu", "os_type": "linux", "cpu": 2, "ram_mb": 4096, "billing_catalog": '"$BILLING_CATALOG"'}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/create-cloud-vm

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `X-Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key used to safely retry write operations.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a CreateCloudVmRequest.

- `name` (string, required) — Display name for the virtual machine.
- `site_id` (string, required) — Placement site ID from `GET /compute/sites`. Required: the API refuses a create without it (400 `invalid_site_id`). Use the same value when filtering plans and images.
- `os_distro` (string, required) — Operating system distribution (e.g. ubuntu, centos, debian, rocky, windows).
- `os_type` (enum, required) — Operating system family.
  - Allowed values: `linux`, `windows`
- `template_id` (string, required) — OS template or image ID returned by the compute catalog.
- `cpu` (integer, required) — Number of vCPUs.
- `ram_mb` (integer, required) — RAM in megabytes.
- `plan_id` (string, required) — Billable compute plan ID returned by the compute catalog.
- `billing_catalog` (map from string to any, required) — The selected plan's `billing_catalog` object from `GET /compute/plans`, passed through unmodified — the same flow the portal uses. Treat it as opaque. Billing charges are always computed server-side from `plan_id`, not from this echoed copy.
- `disk_gb` (integer, optional, nullable) — Root disk size in gigabytes.
- `ssh_key_ids` (list of string, optional) — SSH key IDs to inject into the VM.
- `ssh_keys` (list of string, optional) — Inline public SSH keys to install on the VM, in addition to the keys referenced by `ssh_key_ids`.
- `vpc_id` (string, optional, nullable) — VPC to launch the VM into. Send it together with `subnet_id`; one without the other is refused. Omit both to launch on the public provider network.
- `subnet_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Subnet of `vpc_id` for the VM's VPC NIC. Send it together with `vpc_id`.
- `network_connectivity` (enum, optional, nullable) — How the VM reaches the internet. With a VPC it defaults to `private`. Without a VPC it is accepted only as `public_ip` together with `reserved_public_ip_id`, which attaches that Reserved IP on the public provider network. `public_ip` is refused on a `nat_gateway` VPC, and on a `private` VPC it needs `reserved_public_ip_id`.
  - Allowed values: `private`, `nat`, `public_ip`
- `vpc_attachment_mode` (enum, optional, default: primary) — With a VPC, `primary` makes the VPC NIC the VM's only NIC. `secondary` keeps the public provider NIC as primary and adds the VPC as a second NIC; it needs `vpc_id` and `subnet_id` and cannot be combined with `reserved_public_ip_id`.
  - Allowed values: `primary`, `secondary`
- `reserved_public_ip_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Reserved IP to attach at launch. Needs `network_connectivity: public_ip` and the `primary` attachment mode. Accepted with a VPC or, without one, on the public provider network.
- `tags` (list of string, optional) — Arbitrary tags for filtering and organization.

## Response

### 202

VM creation accepted.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — ID of the queued operation.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM the operation acts on.
- `status` (string, required) — Always `accepted`.
- `submitted_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 402 Payment Required Error

Billing refused the request (`billing_denied`). `billing_reason` carries Billing's reason unchanged, for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` (a plan limit) or `resource_usage_unavailable` (Billing could not count usage). `billing_sku_code`, `billing_evaluated_at` and `admission_context_id` identify the decision. Nothing is provisioned; resolve the reason and retry with the same idempotency key where supported.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"net/http"
	"io"
)

func main() {

	url := "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms?workspace_id=710995"

	payload := strings.NewReader("{\n  \"name\": \"web-server-01\",\n  \"site_id\": \"68b99bd78a8eda32ff3f16ea\",\n  \"os_distro\": \"ubuntu\",\n  \"os_type\": \"linux\",\n  \"template_id\": \"tmpl_ubuntu_2204\",\n  \"cpu\": 2,\n  \"ram_mb\": 4096,\n  \"plan_id\": \"019f25b7-c1b3-7a9e-bfb9-8c83e323b517\"\n}")

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, payload)

	req.Header.Add("X-Idempotency-Key", "4f2a9c1e-7b3d-4e8a-9f10-2c5d6e7f8a9b")
	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}
```

# Get a cloud VM

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}

Returns a single cloud VM. Requires scope: vm.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/get-cloud-vm

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Cloud VM returned successfully.

- `id` (string, optional) — Unique VM ID.
- `name` (string, optional) — Display name of the VM.
- `status` (enum, optional) — Lifecycle status of the VM. - `pending`: create accepted, not started yet. - `creating`, `provisioning`: compute, disk and network resources are being allocated. - `configuring`: the guest is being configured (keys, network, cloud-init). - `running`: powered on. - `starting`: a start is in progress. - `stopping`: a stop is in progress. - `stopped`: powered off. - `rebooting`: a reboot is in progress. - `resizing`, `resizing_plan`, `resizing_disk`: a CPU/memory or root-disk change is being applied. - `attaching_volume`, `detaching_volume`: a block volume is being attached or detached. - `deleting`: a delete is in progress. - `deleted`: the VM no longer exists. - `error`: the last operation failed; see the operation or events for detail.
  - Allowed values: `pending`, `creating`, `provisioning`, `configuring`, `running`, `starting`, `stopping`, `stopped`, `rebooting`, `resizing`, `attaching_volume`, `detaching_volume`, `resizing_plan`, `resizing_disk`, `deleting`, `deleted`, `error`
- `cpu` (integer, optional) — vCPUs.
- `ram_mb` (integer, optional) — Memory in MB.
- `disk_gb` (integer, optional) — Root disk size in GB.
- `os_type` (string, optional) — OS family: `linux` or `windows`.
- `os_distro` (string, optional) — OS distribution, for example `ubuntu`.
- `plan_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Name of the compute plan the VM runs on.
- `public_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Public IPv4 address; null when the VM has none.
- `private_ip` (string, optional, nullable) — Private IPv4 address; null when none is assigned.
- `tags` (list of string, optional) — Tags given at creation.
- `created_at` (datetime, optional) — When the VM was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the VM record was last changed (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

title: Delete a cloud VM

# Delete a cloud VM

DELETE https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}
Content-Type: application/json

Deletes a cloud VM. Returns an operation you can poll for status. A VM with an automatically assigned public IP needs `public_ip_action` in the body. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl -X DELETE "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"public_ip_action": "reserve", "reserved_ip_label": "<reserved_ip_label>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/delete-cloud-vm

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `X-Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key used to safely retry write operations.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a VmDeleteRequest.

- `public_ip_action` (enum, optional, nullable) — What to do with the VM's automatically assigned public IP. `reserve` converts it to a Reserved IP in this workspace; `release` releases it with the VM. Required when the VM has an automatically assigned public IP. `reserve` on a VM without one is refused with 400.
  - Allowed values: `reserve`, `release`
- `reserved_ip_label` (string, optional, nullable) — Label for the Reserved IP that `reserve` creates. Blank is treated as not set.
- `reserved_ip_billing_catalog` (VmDeleteRequestReservedIpBillingCatalog, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog identifiers used to bill the Reserved IP that `reserve` creates. Required with `public_ip_action: reserve`, with a non-empty `sku_id`; refused with 400 otherwise.

## Response

### 202

VM deletion accepted.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — ID of the queued operation.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM the operation acts on.
- `status` (string, required) — Always `accepted`.
- `submitted_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).

Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

# Start a cloud VM

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}/actions/start
Content-Type: application/json

Starts a stopped cloud VM. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID/actions/start?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"force": false}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/start-cloud-vm

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `X-Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key used to safely retry write operations.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a PowerActionRequest.

- `force` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Force the action even if the VM is in a transitional state.

## Response

### 202

VM start accepted.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — ID of the queued operation.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM the operation acts on.
- `status` (string, required) — Always `accepted`.
- `submitted_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 409 Conflict Error

The request conflicts with the current resource state.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 423 Locked Error

The organization is suspended (`organization_suspended`), so writes are refused.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

```swift
})
```

title: Reboot a cloud VM

# Reboot a cloud VM

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}/actions/reboot
Content-Type: application/json

Reboots a cloud VM. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID/actions/reboot?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"force": false}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/reboot-cloud-vm

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `X-Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key used to safely retry write operations.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a PowerActionRequest.

- `force` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Force the action even if the VM is in a transitional state.

## Response

### 202

VM reboot accepted.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — ID of the queued operation.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM the operation acts on.
- `status` (string, required) — Always `accepted`.
- `submitted_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

```swift
import Foundation

let headers = [

    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }

dataTask.resume()
```

# Get cloud VM metrics

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}/metrics

Returns current resource-usage metrics for a cloud VM. Requires scope: vm.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID/metrics?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/get-cloud-vm-metrics

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

VM metrics returned successfully.

- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM.
- `vm_type` (enum, required) — - `cloud` - `gpu`
  - Allowed values: `cloud`, `gpu`
- `power_state` (string, required) — Power state observed on the host when the sample was taken: `running`, `stopped`, `paused`, `suspended`, `blocked`, `crashed` or `unknown`.
- `monitoring_status` (enum, required) — - `active`: a recent sample exists. - `stale`: the last sample is older than the freshness threshold. - `unavailable`: no sample has been collected.
  - Allowed values: `active`, `stale`, `unavailable`
- `month_rx_bytes` (integer, required, default: 0) — Bytes received so far in the current calendar month.
- `month_tx_bytes` (integer, required, default: 0) — Bytes transmitted so far in the current calendar month.
- `last_collected_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the sample was collected (ISO 8601).
- `cpu_percent` (double, optional, nullable) — CPU utilisation, 0-100.
- `memory_used_bytes` (integer, optional, nullable) — Memory in use, in bytes.
- `memory_used_percent` (double, optional, nullable) — Memory in use as a percentage of the VM's memory, 0-100.
- `storage_used_bytes` (integer, optional, nullable) — Disk space in use, in bytes.
- `storage_total_bytes` (integer, optional, nullable) — Disk capacity visible to the guest, in bytes.
- `storage_used_percent` (double, optional, nullable) — Disk space in use as a percentage of `storage_total_bytes`, 0-100.
- `storage_provisioned_bytes` (integer, optional, nullable) — Disk capacity provisioned for the VM, in bytes.
- `disk_read_bps` (double, optional, nullable) — Disk read throughput in bytes per second.
- `disk_write_bps` (double, optional, nullable) — Disk write throughput in bytes per second.
- `disk_read_iops` (double, optional, nullable) — Disk read operations per second.
- `disk_write_iops` (double, optional, nullable) — Disk write operations per second.
- `net_rx_bps` (double, optional, nullable) — Network receive rate in bytes per second.
- `net_tx_bps` (double, optional, nullable) — Network transmit rate in bytes per second.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

# Update cloud VM access settings

PATCH https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}/actions/access
Content-Type: application/json

Adds or removes SSH keys, resets the Linux user password, or changes SSH password authentication on a cloud VM without rebooting it. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl -X PATCH "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID/actions/access?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"requested_by": "api", "admin_username": "<admin_username>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/update-cloud-vm-access

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `X-Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key used to safely retry write operations.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a VmAccessUpdateRequest.

- `requested_by` (string, optional, default: api) — Free-text label for who or what made the request, stored with the operation. Default `api`.
- `admin_username` (string, optional, nullable) — Linux account to update. Defaults to the VM admin user.
- `ssh_key_mode` (enum, optional, nullable) — - `add`: install the given keys. - `remove`: remove the given keys.
  - Allowed values: `add`, `remove`
- `ssh_keys` (list of string, optional, default: []) — Inline public SSH keys to add or remove.
- `ssh_key_ids` (list of string, optional, default: []) — Secret Store SSH key IDs to add or remove.
- `ssh_key_secret_refs` (list of SshKeySecretRef, optional, default: []) — SSH public keys kept in Secret Store, referenced by store key and secret name.
- `new_password` (string, optional, nullable) — New password for `admin_username`.
- `password_auth_enabled` (boolean, optional, nullable) — Enable (`true`) or disable (`false`) SSH password authentication.
- `confirm_remove_last_ssh_key` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Must be `true` to remove the VM's last remaining SSH key.

## Response

### 202

Access update accepted.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — ID of the queued operation.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM the operation acts on.
- `status` (string, required) — Always `accepted`.
- `submitted_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).

From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. - `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### SshKeySecretRef

Reference to an SSH public key kept in a Secret Store store.

- `ssh_key_id` (string, required) — ID of the SSH key.
- `secret_name` (string, required) — Name of the secret that holds the public key.
- `store_key` (string, optional, default: ssh-keys) — Store key of the Secret Store store that holds the key. Default `ssh-keys`.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

title: Precheck a cloud VM resize

# Precheck a cloud VM resize

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}/actions/resize/precheck
Content-Type: application/json

Checks whether a cloud VM can take a requested CPU, memory, or root-disk change before you start the resize. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID/actions/resize/precheck?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"cpu": 1, "ram_mb": 1}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/precheck-cloud-vm-resize

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a VmResizeRequest.

- `cpu` (integer, optional) — Target vCPUs.
- `ram_mb` (integer, optional) — Target memory in MB.
- `disk_gb` (integer, optional) — Target root disk size in GB.
- `requested_by` (string, optional, default: api) — Free-text label for who or what made the request, stored with the operation. Default `api`.

## Response

### 200

Resize decision returned successfully.

- `decision` (enum, required) — - `in_place`: the change can be applied on the current host. - `migration_required`: the VM must move to another host first. - `blocked`: the change cannot be made; see `reasons`.
  - Allowed values: `in_place`, `migration_required`, `blocked`
- `reasons` (list of string, required) — Why the decision was reached.
- `warnings` (list of string, required) — Non-blocking warnings about the change.
- `migration_checklist` (list of string, required) — Items to confirm before a migration.
- `migration_steps` (list of string, required) — Steps a migration would perform.
- `requires_stop` (boolean, required) — Whether the VM must be stopped for the change.
- `downtime_expected` (boolean, required) — Whether the change interrupts the VM.
- `no_changes` (boolean, required) — True when the target shape equals the current one.
- `current_state` (string, required) — VM lifecycle status recorded by the engine.
- `current` (VmResizeShape, required) — A VM shape: vCPUs, memory and root disk.
- `target` (VmResizeShape, required) — A VM shape: vCPUs, memory and root disk.
- `mode` (enum, optional, nullable) — Same values as `decision`; present when the engine reports the mode separately.
  - Allowed values: `in_place`, `migration_required`, `blocked`
- `live_state` (string, optional, nullable) — Power state observed on the host, when available.

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.

# Resize a cloud VM

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}/actions/resize
Content-Type: application/json

Changes a cloud VM's CPU and memory, and optionally grows its root disk, after the same precheck the portal runs. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID/actions/resize?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"cpu": 1, "ram_mb": 1}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/resize-cloud-vm

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `X-Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key used to safely retry write operations.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a VmResizeRequest.

- `cpu` (integer, optional) — Target vCPUs.
- `ram_mb` (integer, optional) — Target memory in MB.
- `disk_gb` (integer, optional) — Target root disk size in GB.
- `requested_by` (string, optional, default: api) — Free-text label for who or what made the request, stored with the operation. Default `api`.

## Response

### 202

VM resize accepted.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — ID of the queued operation.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM the operation acts on.
- `status` (string, required) — Always `accepted`.
- `submitted_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).

Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

# Resize a cloud VM plan

PATCH https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}/actions/resize-plan
Content-Type: application/json

Moves a cloud VM to a different CPU and memory plan. Downgrades require explicit confirmation. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl -X PATCH "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID/actions/resize-plan?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"cpu": 1, "ram_mb": 1}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/resize-cloud-vm-plan

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `X-Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key used to safely retry write operations.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a VmResizePlanRequest.

- `cpu` (integer, required) — Target vCPUs (1-256).
- `ram_mb` (integer, required) — Target memory in MB.
- `allow_online` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Permit the change while the VM is running. Default false.
- `confirm_downgrade` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Must be `true` when the target shape is smaller than the current one.
- `billing_catalog` (BillingCatalogSelection, optional) — Optional. The target plan's `billing_catalog` from `GET /compute/plans`. The VM engine records it with the resize.
- `requested_by` (string, optional, default: api) — Free-text label for who or what made the request, stored with the operation. Default `api`.

## Response

### 202

Plan resize accepted.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — ID of the queued operation.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM the operation acts on.
- `status` (string, required) — Always `accepted`.
- `submitted_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).

title: Resize a cloud VM root disk
url: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/resize-cloud-vm-root-disk

# Resize a cloud VM root disk

PATCH https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/{vm_id}/actions/resize-root-disk
Content-Type: application/json

Increases a cloud VM's root disk size. Shrinking a root disk is not supported. Requires scope: vm.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VM_ID: Virtual machine ID
curl -X PATCH "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/compute/cloud-vms/$VM_ID/actions/resize-root-disk?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"new_size_gb": 1}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cloud-vms/resize-cloud-vm-root-disk

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `vm_id` (string, required) — Virtual machine ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `X-Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key used to safely retry write operations.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a VmResizeRootDiskRequest.

- `new_size_gb` (integer, required) — Target root disk size in GB.
- `allow_online` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Permit the change while the VM is running. Default false.
- `billing_catalog` (BillingCatalogSelection, optional) — Optional. A Billing catalog selection that the VM engine records with the resize.
- `requested_by` (string, optional, default: api) — Free-text label for who or what made the request, stored with the operation. Default `api`.

## Response

### 202

Root-disk resize accepted.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — ID of the queued operation.
- `vm_id` (string, required) — ID of the VM the operation acts on.
- `status` (string, required) — Always `accepted`.
- `submitted_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).

Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

```swift
  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
```

title: Attach a volume to a cloud VM
