# Check resource billing eligibility

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/billing/resource-eligibility
Content-Type: application/json

Returns a point-in-time eligibility decision from the same existing billing service used by the portal. Call it before a billable create and continue only when `allowed` is exactly `true`. This check does not reserve funds, create a resource, or guarantee that a later product operation will succeed. Requires scope: billing.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/billing/resource-eligibility?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sku_code": "STANDARD-2-8-50", "estimated_cost_minor": 120000}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/billing/check-resource-eligibility

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a BillingEligibilityRequest.

- `sku_code` (string, optional) — Billing catalog SKU for the intended resource. Unknown or unavailable SKUs may be denied.
- `estimated_cost_minor` (integer, optional) — Optional estimated cost expressed in the organization's currency minor unit. Use a value from a trusted catalog.
- `operation` (enum, optional, default: CREATE_RESOURCE) — The kind of action Billing should decide on.
  - Allowed values: `CREATE_RESOURCE`, `CREATE_CREDENTIAL`, `INCREASE_CAPACITY`, `MUTATE_RESOURCE`, `READ_RESOURCE`, `DELETE_RESOURCE`, `REVOKE_CREDENTIAL`, `SECURITY_RECOVERY`
- `resource_type` (enum, optional, nullable) — What the request would create, so Billing also checks the plan's resource limit for it. Omit it for a money check only. `bucket`, `secret_store` and `secret` have no limit and get the money check only.
  - Allowed values: `cpu_vm`, `gpu_vm`, `block_volume`, `snapshot`, `cdn_zone`, `load_balancer`, `public_ipv4`, `bucket`, `secret_store`, `secret`
- `quantity` (integer, optional, default: 1) — How many resources would be created at once; 0 for a resize, which adds size only.
- `size_gb` (integer, optional, nullable) — GiB being added (a new volume's size, a resize's increase, or the disks a snapshot will capture), checked against the size limit of that kind.

## Response

### 200

Billing eligibility decision returned successfully.

- `organization_id` (string, required) — Organization the decision is for.
- `allowed` (boolean, required) — Continue only when this value is exactly true.
- `reason` (string, required) — Machine-readable decision reason. A refusal for a plan limit is `resource_limit_reached`, with the `resource_limit_*` fields set; `resource_usage_unavailable` means Billing could not count usage.
- `billing_mode` (enum, required) — - `PREPAID`: usage is paid from a wallet balance. - `POSTPAID`: usage is invoiced against a credit limit.
  - Allowed values: `PREPAID`, `POSTPAID`
- `billing_state` (enum, required) — Payment standing of the organization. - `CURRENT`: in good standing. - `PAYMENT_DUE`: an invoice is open. - `PAST_DUE`: an invoice is overdue. - `SOFT_SUSPENDED`: new purchases are blocked. - `HARD_SUSPENDED`: service is suspended.
  - Allowed values: `CURRENT`, `PAYMENT_DUE`, `PAST_DUE`, `SOFT_SUSPENDED`, `HARD_SUSPENDED`
- `currency` (string, required) — ISO 4217 code of the organization's billing currency; the `*_minor` amounts are in its minor unit.
- `evaluated_at` (datetime, required) — When Billing made the decision (ISO 8601).
- `sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — SKU the decision was evaluated for, when one was given.
- `estimated_cost_minor` (integer, optional, nullable) — Estimated cost that was evaluated, in the currency's minor unit.
- `effective_balance_minor` (integer, optional, nullable) — Balance available to spend, in the currency's minor unit; null when not applicable.
- `credit_headroom_minor` (integer, optional, nullable) — Remaining credit before the organization's limit, in the currency's minor unit; null when not applicable.
- `resource_limits` (map from string to integer, optional) — How many of each resource the organization's plan allows, keyed by limit (for example `cpu_vm` or `block_storage_gb`). A missing key or `-1` means unlimited.
- `resource_limit_key` (string, optional, nullable) — The limit that refused the request, when a resource limit decided it.
- `resource_limit` (integer, optional, nullable) — The value of that limit.
- `resource_usage` (double, optional, nullable) — Current usage counted against that limit (a count, or GiB for a size limit).

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.

# List block-storage volumes

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes

Lists the block storage volumes in a workspace, with their size, status, and attached VM. Requires scope: block-storage.read.

```

curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
```

## Types

### BlockVolume

A block storage volume.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the volume.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the volume.
- `size_gb` (integer, required) — Size in GB.
- `state` (enum, required) — Lifecycle state of the volume. - `creating`: being provisioned. - `ready`: provisioned and detached. - `in-use`: attached to a node. - `attaching`, `detaching`: an attachment change is in progress. - `resizing`: a resize is in progress. - `deleting`: being removed. - `error`: the last operation failed; see its `error`.
  - Allowed values: `creating`, `ready`, `in-use`, `attaching`, `detaching`, `resizing`, `deleting`, `error`
- `volume_class` (enum, required) — Performance class of the volume. - `capacity`: lowest cost per GB. - `balanced`: general purpose. - `performance`: highest throughput and IOPS.
  - Allowed values: `capacity`, `balanced`, `performance`
- `replica_count` (integer, required) — Number of synchronous replicas kept for the volume.
- `attachments` (list of BlockVolumeAttachment, required) — Current attachments; empty when detached.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `workspace_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the workspace.
- `site_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Site the volume lives at.
- `site_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that site.
- `metadata` (BlockVolumeMetadata, optional) — Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

### BlockVolumeAttachment

An active attachment of a volume to a compute node and, when known, the VM on it.

- `node_name` (string, required) — Compute node the volume is attached to.
- `mode` (enum, required) — - `single-writer`: only this node may write to the volume. - `multi-writer`: the volume may be attached to several nodes.
  - Allowed values: `single-writer`, `multi-writer`
- `device_path` (string, required) — Device path on the node, for example `/dev/drbd1000`.
- `attached_at` (datetime, required) — When the attachment was made (ISO 8601).
- `vm_id` (string, optional, nullable) — ID of the VM the volume is attached to, when known.
- `vm_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that VM.

### BlockVolumeMetadata

- `billing_catalog` (BillingCatalogSelection, optional) — The Block Storage SKU this volume is billed under. Pass it as `billing_catalog` when attaching the volume to a VM.

### BillingCatalogSelection

A Billing catalog SKU selection as the VM engine accepts it. `sku_id` and `sku_code` are required; other catalog fields are accepted and stored as sent.

- `sku_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionSkuId, required) — Billing catalog SKU ID.
- `sku_code` (string, required) — Billing catalog SKU code. Stored in upper case.
- `product_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionProductId, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog product ID.

---
title: Create block-storage volume
url: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/create-block-volume
---

# Create block-storage volume

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes
Content-Type: application/json

The public edge resolves authoritative pricing from the server-owned product catalog and validates billing before forwarding this request to the existing portal volume flow. Client-supplied price or billing catalog objects are not accepted.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "<name>", "size_gb": 1, "site_id": "68b99bd78a8eda32ff3f16ea"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/create-block-volume

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a CreateBlockVolumeRequest.

- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the volume (1-255 characters).
- `size_gb` (integer, required) — Size in GB (1-10000).
- `site_id` (string, required) — Site to create the volume at.
- `site_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that site, as shown in the portal.
- `sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — Optional public selector returned by the server-owned Block Storage catalog. The edge resolves all price and catalog metadata; callers cannot submit pricing.
- `volume_class` (enum, optional, default: balanced) — Performance class of the volume. - `capacity`: lowest cost per GB. - `balanced`: general purpose. - `performance`: highest throughput and IOPS. Default `balanced`.
  - Allowed values: `capacity`, `balanced`, `performance`
- `replica_count` (integer, optional, default: 2) — Number of synchronous replicas kept for the volume (1-5). Default 2.
- `backup_enabled` (boolean, optional, default: true) — Whether volume backups are enabled. Default true.
- `idempotency_key` (string, optional, nullable) — Caller-chosen key that makes a retried request return the original operation instead of starting a new one.

## Response

### 200

Volume created successfully.

- `volume` (BlockVolume, required) — A block storage volume.
- `operation` (BlockVolumeOperation, required) — One operation run on a volume.

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 402 Payment Required Error

Billing refused the request (`billing_denied`). `billing_reason` carries Billing's reason unchanged, for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` (a plan limit) or `resource_usage_unavailable` (Billing could not count usage). `billing_sku_code`, `billing_evaluated_at` and `admission_context_id` identify the decision. Nothing is provisioned; resolve the reason and retry with the same idempotency key where supported.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 423 Locked Error

The organization is suspended (`organization_suspended`), so writes are refused.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

## Types

### BlockVolume

A block storage volume.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the volume.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the volume.
- `size_gb` (integer, required) — Size in GB.
- `state` (enum, required) — Lifecycle state of the volume. - `creating`: being provisioned. - `ready`: provisioned and detached. - `in-use`: attached to a node. - `attaching`, `detaching`: an attachment change is in progress. - `resizing`: a resize is in progress. - `deleting`: being removed. - `error`: the last operation failed; see its `error`.
  - Allowed values: `creating`, `ready`, `in-use`, `attaching`, `detaching`, `resizing`, `deleting`, `error`
- `volume_class` (enum, required) — Performance class of the volume. - `capacity`: lowest cost per GB. - `balanced`: general purpose. - `performance`: highest throughput and IOPS.
  - Allowed values: `capacity`, `balanced`, `performance`
- `replica_count` (integer, required) — Number of synchronous replicas kept for the volume.
- `attachments` (list of BlockVolumeAttachment, required) — Current attachments; empty when detached.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `workspace_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the workspace.
- `site_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Site the volume lives at.
- `site_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that site.
- `metadata` (BlockVolumeMetadata, optional) — Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

### BlockVolumeOperation

One operation run on a volume.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the operation.
- `volume_id` (string, required) — Volume the operation acts on.
- `operation` (enum, required) — - `create` - `attach` - `detach` - `resize` - `delete`
  - Allowed values: `create`, `attach`, `detach`, `resize`, `delete`
- `status` (enum, required) — - `in-progress`: running. - `succeeded`: finished successfully. - `failed`: finished with an error; see `error`.
  - Allowed values: `in-progress`, `succeeded`, `failed`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).
- `started_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation started (ISO 8601).
- `idempotency_key` (string, optional, nullable) — Idempotency key the request was made with, when one was given.
- `result` (map from string to any, optional) — Operation-specific result details as key-value data.
- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `failed`.
- `completed_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the operation finished (ISO 8601); null while running.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

### BlockVolumeAttachment

An active attachment of a volume to a compute node and, when known, the VM on it.

- `node_name` (string, required) — Compute node the volume is attached to.
- `mode` (enum, required) — - `single-writer`: only this node may write to the volume. - `multi-writer`: the volume may be attached to several nodes.
  - Allowed values: `single-writer`, `multi-writer`
- `device_path` (string, required) — Device path on the node, for example `/dev/drbd1000`.
- `attached_at` (datetime, required) — When the attachment was made (ISO 8601).
- `vm_id` (string, optional, nullable) — ID of the VM the volume is attached to, when known.
- `vm_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that VM.

### BlockVolumeMetadata

Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

- `billing_catalog` (BillingCatalogSelection, optional) — The Block Storage SKU this volume is billed under. Pass it as `billing_catalog` when attaching the volume to a VM.

### BillingCatalogSelection

- `product_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionProductId, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog product ID.

```go
	payload := strings.NewReader("{\n  \"name\": \"<name>\",\n  \"size_gb\": 1,\n  \"site_id\": \"68b99bd78a8eda32ff3f16ea\"\n}")

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, payload)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}
```

# Get block-storage volume

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/{volume_id}

Returns a block storage volume, including its size, status, and the VM it is attached to. Requires scope: block-storage.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VOLUME_ID: Workspace-owned block-volume ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/$VOLUME_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/get-block-volume

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `volume_id` (string, required) — Workspace-owned block-volume ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Volume returned successfully.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the volume.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the volume.
- `size_gb` (integer, required) — Size in GB.
- `state` (enum, required) — Lifecycle state of the volume. - `creating`: being provisioned. - `ready`: provisioned and detached. - `in-use`: attached to a node. - `attaching`, `detaching`: an attachment change is in progress. - `resizing`: a resize is in progress. - `deleting`: being removed. - `error`: the last operation failed; see its `error`.
  - Allowed values: `creating`, `ready`, `in-use`, `attaching`, `detaching`, `resizing`, `deleting`, `error`
- `volume_class` (enum, required) — Performance class of the volume. - `capacity`: lowest cost per GB. - `balanced`: general purpose. - `performance`: highest throughput and IOPS.
  - Allowed values: `capacity`, `balanced`, `performance`
- `replica_count` (integer, required) — Number of synchronous replicas kept for the volume.
- `attachments` (list of BlockVolumeAttachment, required) — Current attachments; empty when detached.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `workspace_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the workspace.
- `site_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Site the volume lives at.
- `site_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that site.
- `metadata` (BlockVolumeMetadata, optional) — Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### BlockVolumeAttachment

An active attachment of a volume to a compute node and, when known, the VM on it.

- `node_name` (string, required) — Compute node the volume is attached to.
- `mode` (enum, required) — - `single-writer`: only this node may write to the volume. - `multi-writer`: the volume may be attached to several nodes.
  - Allowed values: `single-writer`, `multi-writer`
- `device_path` (string, required) — Device path on the node, for example `/dev/drbd1000`.
- `attached_at` (datetime, required) — When the attachment was made (ISO 8601).
- `vm_id` (string, optional, nullable) — ID of the VM the volume is attached to, when known.
- `vm_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that VM.

### BlockVolumeMetadata

Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

- `billing_catalog` (BillingCatalogSelection, optional) — The Block Storage SKU this volume is billed under. Pass it as `billing_catalog` when attaching the volume to a VM.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

### BillingCatalogSelection

A Billing catalog SKU selection as the VM engine accepts it. `sku_id` and `sku_code` are required; other catalog fields are accepted and stored as sent.

- `sku_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionSkuId, required) — Billing catalog SKU ID.
- `sku_code` (string, required) — Billing catalog SKU code. Stored in upper case.
- `product_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionProductId, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog product ID.
- `product_code` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog product code.
- `display_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the SKU, as listed in the billing catalog.

### BillingCatalogSelectionSkuId

Billing catalog SKU ID.

- string
- double

### BillingCatalogSelectionProductId

Billing catalog product ID.

- string
- double

# Delete block-storage volume

DELETE https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/{volume_id}

Permanently deletes a block storage volume and its data. Requires scope: block-storage.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VOLUME_ID: Workspace-owned block-volume ID
curl -X DELETE "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/$VOLUME_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/delete-block-volume

- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

### Path parameters

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.
- `force` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Delete the volume even if it is still attached. Default false.

## Response

### 200

Volume deletion completed.

- `status` (enum, required) — Always `deleted`.

### 423 Locked Error

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.

# List block-volume operations

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/{volume_id}/operations

Lists the operations run on a block storage volume and their status. Requires scope: block-storage.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VOLUME_ID: Workspace-owned block-volume ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/$VOLUME_ID/operations?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/list-block-volume-operations

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `failed`.
- `completed_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the operation finished (ISO 8601); null while running.

# Attach block-storage volume

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/{volume_id}/attachments
Content-Type: application/json

Attaches a block storage volume to a VM so it can be mounted in the guest. Requires scope: block-storage.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VOLUME_ID: Workspace-owned block-volume ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/$VOLUME_ID/attachments?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"node_name": "<node_name>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/attach-block-volume

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `volume_id` (string, required) — Workspace-owned block-volume ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects an AttachBlockVolumeRequest.

- `node_name` (string, required) — Compute node to attach the volume to.
- `mode` (enum, optional, default: single-writer) — - `single-writer`: only this node may write to the volume. - `multi-writer`: the volume may be attached to several nodes. Default `single-writer`.
  - Allowed values: `single-writer`, `multi-writer`
- `vm_id` (string, optional, nullable) — ID of the VM that will use the volume.
- `vm_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that VM.
- `vm_state` (enum, optional, nullable) — Current power state of the VM, when the caller knows it. - `running` - `stopped` - `suspended`
  - Allowed values: `running`, `stopped`, `suspended`
- `vm_site_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Site of that VM.
- `vm_type` (enum, optional, default: cloud) — Kind of VM the volume is used with. - `cloud` (default) - `gpu`
  - Allowed values: `cloud`, `gpu`
- `idempotency_key` (string, optional, nullable) — Caller-chosen key that makes a retried request return the original operation instead of starting a new one.

## Response

### 200

Volume attached successfully.

- `volume` (BlockVolume, required) — A block storage volume.
- `operation` (BlockVolumeOperation, required) — One operation run on a volume.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 423 Locked Error

The organization is suspended (`organization_suspended`), so writes are refused.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### BlockVolume

A block storage volume.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the volume.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the volume.
- `size_gb` (integer, required) — Size in GB.
- `state` (enum, required) — Lifecycle state of the volume. - `creating`: being provisioned. - `ready`: provisioned and detached. - `in-use`: attached to a node. - `attaching`, `detaching`: an attachment change is in progress. - `resizing`: a resize is in progress. - `deleting`: being removed. - `error`: the last operation failed; see its `error`.
  - Allowed values: `creating`, `ready`, `in-use`, `attaching`, `detaching`, `resizing`, `deleting`, `error`
- `volume_class` (enum, required) — Performance class of the volume. - `capacity`: lowest cost per GB. - `balanced`: general purpose. - `performance`: highest throughput and IOPS.
  - Allowed values: `capacity`, `balanced`, `performance`
- `replica_count` (integer, required) — Number of synchronous replicas kept for the volume.
- `attachments` (list of BlockVolumeAttachment, required) — Current attachments; empty when detached.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `workspace_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the workspace.
- `site_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Site the volume lives at.
- `site_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that site.
- `metadata` (BlockVolumeMetadata, optional) — Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

### BlockVolumeOperation

One operation run on a volume.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the operation.
- `volume_id` (string, required) — Volume the operation acts on.
- `operation` (enum, required) — - `create` - `attach` - `detach` - `resize` - `delete`
  - Allowed values: `create`, `attach`, `detach`, `resize`, `delete`
- `status` (enum, required) — - `in-progress`: running. - `succeeded`: finished successfully. - `failed`: finished with an error; see `error`.
  - Allowed values: `in-progress`, `succeeded`, `failed`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).
- `started_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation started (ISO 8601).
- `idempotency_key` (string, optional, nullable) — Idempotency key the request was made with, when one was given.
- `result` (map from string to any, optional) — Operation-specific result details as key-value data.
- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `failed`.
- `completed_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the operation finished (ISO 8601); null while running.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

### BlockVolumeAttachment

An active attachment of a volume to a compute node and, when known, the VM on it.

- `node_name` (string, required) — Compute node the volume is attached to.
- `mode` (enum, required) — - `single-writer`: only this node may write to the volume. - `multi-writer`: the volume may be attached to several nodes.
  - Allowed values: `single-writer`, `multi-writer`
- `device_path` (string, required) — Device path on the node, for example `/dev/drbd1000`.
- `attached_at` (datetime, required) — When the attachment was made (ISO 8601).
- `vm_id` (string, optional, nullable) — ID of the VM the volume is attached to, when known.
- `vm_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that VM.

### BlockVolumeMetadata

Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

- `billing_catalog` (BillingCatalogSelection, optional) — The Block Storage SKU this volume is billed under. Pass it as `billing_catalog` when attaching the volume to a VM.

### BillingCatalogSelection

A Billing catalog SKU selection as the VM engine accepts it. `sku_id` and `sku_code` are required; other catalog fields are accepted and stored as sent.

- `sku_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionSkuId, required) — Billing catalog SKU ID.
- `sku_code` (string, required) — Billing catalog SKU code. Stored in upper case.
- `product_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionProductId, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog product ID.
- `product_code` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog product code.
- `display_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the SKU, as listed in the billing catalog.

### BillingCatalogSelectionSkuId

Billing catalog SKU ID.

- string
- double

### BillingCatalogSelectionProductId

Billing catalog product ID.

- string
- double

# Detach block-storage volume

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/{volume_id}/detach
Content-Type: application/json

Detaches a block storage volume from its VM. Unmount it in the guest first. Requires scope: block-storage.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VOLUME_ID: Workspace-owned block-volume ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/$VOLUME_ID/detach?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"node_name": "<node_name>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/detach-block-volume

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `volume_id` (string, required) — Workspace-owned block-volume ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a DetachBlockVolumeRequest.

- `node_name` (string, required) — Compute node to detach the volume from.
- `force` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Detach even if the volume still appears to be in use. Default false.
- `confirm_unmounted` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Confirms the volume was unmounted inside the guest. Default false.
- `vm_state` (enum, optional, nullable) — Current power state of the VM, when the caller knows it. - `running` - `stopped` - `suspended`
  - Allowed values: `running`, `stopped`, `suspended`
- `vm_type` (enum, optional, default: cloud) — Kind of VM the volume is used with. - `cloud` (default) - `gpu`
  - Allowed values: `cloud`, `gpu`
- `reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Optional free-text reason recorded with the operation.
- `idempotency_key` (string, optional, nullable) — Caller-chosen key that makes a retried request return the original operation instead of starting a new one.

## Response

### 200

Volume detached successfully.

- `volume` (BlockVolume, required) — A block storage volume.
- `operation` (BlockVolumeOperation, required) — One operation run on a volume.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. - `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `workspace_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the workspace.
- `site_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Site the volume lives at.
- `site_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that site.
- `metadata` (BlockVolumeMetadata, optional) — Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

### BlockVolumeOperation

One operation run on a volume.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the operation.
- `volume_id` (string, required) — Volume the operation acts on.
- `operation` (enum, required) — - `create` - `attach` - `detach` - `resize` - `delete`
  - Allowed values: `create`, `attach`, `detach`, `resize`, `delete`
- `status` (enum, required) — - `in-progress`: running. - `succeeded`: finished successfully. - `failed`: finished with an error; see `error`.
  - Allowed values: `in-progress`, `succeeded`, `failed`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was accepted (ISO 8601).
- `started_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation started (ISO 8601).
- `idempotency_key` (string, optional, nullable) — Idempotency key the request was made with, when one was given.
- `result` (map from string to any, optional) — Operation-specific result details as key-value data.
- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Error detail when `status` is `failed`.
- `completed_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the operation finished (ISO 8601); null while running.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

### BlockVolumeAttachment

An active attachment of a volume to a compute node and, when known, the VM on it.

- `node_name` (string, required) — Compute node the volume is attached to.
- `mode` (enum, required) — - `single-writer`: only this node may write to the volume. - `multi-writer`: the volume may be attached to several nodes.
  - Allowed values: `single-writer`, `multi-writer`
- `device_path` (string, required) — Device path on the node, for example `/dev/drbd1000`.
- `attached_at` (datetime, required) — When the attachment was made (ISO 8601).
- `vm_id` (string, optional, nullable) — ID of the VM the volume is attached to, when known.
- `vm_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that VM.

### BlockVolumeMetadata

Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

- `billing_catalog` (BillingCatalogSelection, optional) — The Block Storage SKU this volume is billed under. Pass it as `billing_catalog` when attaching the volume to a VM.

### BillingCatalogSelection

A Billing catalog SKU selection as the VM engine accepts it. `sku_id` and `sku_code` are required; other catalog fields are accepted and stored as sent.

- `sku_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionSkuId, required) — Billing catalog SKU ID.
- `sku_code` (string, required) — Billing catalog SKU code. Stored in upper case.
- `product_id` (BillingCatalogSelectionProductId, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog product ID.
- `product_code` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing catalog product code.
- `display_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the SKU, as listed in the billing catalog.

### BillingCatalogSelectionSkuId

Billing catalog SKU ID.

- string
- double

### BillingCatalogSelectionProductId

Billing catalog product ID.

- string
- double

title: Resize block-storage volume
url: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/resize-block-volume

# Resize block-storage volume

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/{volume_id}/resize
Content-Type: application/json

Block volumes can only be increased in size.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# VOLUME_ID: Workspace-owned block-volume ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/block-storage/volumes/$VOLUME_ID/resize?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"new_size_gb": 1}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/block-storage/resize-block-volume

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `volume_id` (string, required) — Workspace-owned block-volume ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a ResizeBlockVolumeRequest.

- `new_size_gb` (integer, required) — New size in GB.
- `vm_state` (enum, optional, nullable) — Current power state of the VM, when the caller knows it. - `running` - `stopped` - `suspended`
  - Allowed values: `running`, `stopped`, `suspended`
- `allow_online` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Permit the resize while the volume is attached to a running VM. Default false.
- `idempotency_key` (string, optional, nullable) — Caller-chosen key that makes a retried request return the original operation instead of starting a new one.

## Response

### 200

Volume resized successfully.

- `volume` (BlockVolume, required) — A block storage volume.
- `operation` (BlockVolumeOperation, required) — One operation run on a volume.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### BlockVolume

A block storage volume.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the volume.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the volume.
- `size_gb` (integer, required) — Size in GB.
- `state` (enum, required) — Lifecycle state of the volume. - `creating`: being provisioned. - `ready`: provisioned and detached. - `in-use`: attached to a node. - `attaching`, `detaching`: an attachment change is in progress. - `resizing`: a resize is in progress. - `deleting`: being removed. - `error`: the last operation failed; see its `error`.
  - Allowed values: `creating`, `ready`, `in-use`, `attaching`, `detaching`, `resizing`, `deleting`, `error`
- `volume_class` (enum, required) — Performance class of the volume. - `capacity`: lowest cost per GB. - `balanced`: general purpose. - `performance`: highest throughput and IOPS.
  - Allowed values: `capacity`, `balanced`, `performance`
- `replica_count` (integer, required) — Number of synchronous replicas kept for the volume.
- `attachments` (list of BlockVolumeAttachment, required) — Current attachments; empty when detached.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the volume was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `organization_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, optional) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `workspace_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of the workspace.
- `site_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Site the volume lives at.
- `site_name` (string, optional, nullable) — Display name of that site.
- `metadata` (BlockVolumeMetadata, optional) — Additional key-value data, including the `billing_catalog` the volume was created with.

- `status` (enum, required) — - `in-progress`: running. - `succeeded`: finished successfully. - `failed`: finished with an error; see `error`.
  - Allowed values: `in-progress`, `succeeded`, `failed`

# Generate CDN object URL

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/generate-url
Content-Type: application/json

Generates a time-limited CDN URL for an object in an object storage bucket, with optional download disposition. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/generate-url?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"bucket_name": "<bucket_name>", "object_key": "<object_key>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/generate-cdn-url

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a GenerateCdnUrlRequest.

- `bucket_name` (string, required) — Name of the bucket.
- `object_key` (string, required) — Object key (path) inside the bucket.
- `expires_in` (integer, optional, nullable) — Lifetime of the URL in seconds. Omit for a URL that does not expire.
- `disposition` (enum, optional, nullable) — - `inline`: the browser displays the object. - `attachment`: the browser downloads it.
  - Allowed values: `inline`, `attachment`

## Response

### 200

CDN URL generated successfully.

- `cdn_url` (string, required) — The generated URL.
- `expires_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the URL stops working (ISO 8601); null when it does not expire.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

### 423 Locked Error

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions

Lists the CDN distributions in a workspace. Requires scope: cdn.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \

```

## Types

### CdnDistribution

A CDN distribution in front of a bucket or custom origin.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the distribution.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the distribution.
- `origin_type` (enum, required) — - `bucket`: an Object Storage bucket. - `custom`: a custom origin.
  - Allowed values: `bucket`, `custom`
- `origin_id` (string, required) — Bucket name or custom origin ID.
- `cache_policy` (string, required) — Caching behaviour in effect. - `static-assets`: long-term caching for immutable assets; 1 year at the CDN, browsers revalidate. - `media`: medium-term caching for video and audio; 30 days at the CDN. - `short`: short-term caching for frequently changing content; 1 hour at the CDN. - `no-cache`: no caching, for dynamic responses.
- `enabled` (boolean, required) — Whether the distribution serves traffic.
- `status` (enum, required) — - `active`: serving. - `deploying`: configuration is being rolled out to the edge. - `disabled`: turned off. - `failed`: deployment failed. - `deleted`: removed.
  - Allowed values: `active`, `deploying`, `disabled`, `failed`, `deleted`
- `default_domain` (string, required) — Hostname IBEE assigned to the distribution, for example `dl-abc123.cdn.ibee.ai`.
