# Create CDN distribution

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions
Content-Type: application/json

Creates a CDN distribution that caches and serves content from an object storage bucket or other origin through the edge network. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "<name>", "origin_id": "<origin_id>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/create-cdn-distribution

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a CreateCdnDistributionRequest.

- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the distribution (1-128 characters).
- `origin_id` (string, required) — Bucket name for `bucket` origins, or the custom origin's ID.
- `origin_type` (enum, optional, default: bucket) — - `bucket`: serve an Object Storage bucket (default). - `custom`: serve a custom origin.
  - Allowed values: `bucket`, `custom`
- `cache_policy` (enum, optional, default: static-assets) — Caching behaviour. Default `static-assets`. - `static-assets`: long-term caching for immutable assets; 1 year at the CDN, browsers revalidate. - `media`: medium-term caching for video and audio; 30 days at the CDN. - `short`: short-term caching for frequently changing content; 1 hour at the CDN. - `no-cache`: no caching, for dynamic responses.
  - Allowed values: `static-assets`, `media`, `short`, `no-cache`

## Response

### 201

Distribution created successfully.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the distribution.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the distribution.
- `origin_type` (enum, required) — - `bucket`: an Object Storage bucket. - `custom`: a custom origin.
  - Allowed values: `bucket`, `custom`
- `origin_id` (string, required) — Bucket name or custom origin ID.
- `cache_policy` (string, required) — Caching behaviour in effect. - `static-assets`: long-term caching for immutable assets; 1 year at the CDN, browsers revalidate. - `media`: medium-term caching for video and audio; 30 days at the CDN. - `short`: short-term caching for frequently changing content; 1 hour at the CDN. - `no-cache`: no caching, for dynamic responses.
- `enabled` (boolean, required) — Whether the distribution serves traffic.
- `status` (enum, required) — - `active`: serving. - `deploying`: configuration is being rolled out to the edge. - `disabled`: turned off. - `failed`: deployment failed. - `deleted`: removed.
  - Allowed values: `active`, `deploying`, `disabled`, `failed`, `deleted`
- `default_domain` (string, required) — Hostname IBEE assigned to the distribution, for example `dl-abc123.cdn.ibee.ai`.
- `default_url` (string, required) — `https://` URL of `default_domain`.
- `custom_domains` (list of string, required) — Custom hostnames attached to the distribution.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the distribution was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the distribution was last changed (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

### 402 Payment Required Error

Billing refused the request (`billing_denied`). `billing_reason` carries Billing's reason unchanged, for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` (a plan limit) or `resource_usage_unavailable` (Billing could not count usage). `billing_sku_code`, `billing_evaluated_at` and `admission_context_id` identify the decision. Nothing is provisioned; resolve the reason and retry with the same idempotency key where supported.

# Get CDN distribution

Returns a CDN distribution's origin, cache policy, domains, and status. Requires scope: cdn.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
```

- `custom_domains` (list of string, required) — Custom hostnames attached to the distribution.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the distribution was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the distribution was last changed (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.

# Delete CDN distribution

DELETE https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}

Deletes a CDN distribution. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
curl -X DELETE "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/delete-cdn-distribution

# Update CDN distribution

PATCH https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}
Content-Type: application/json

Changes a CDN distribution's name, origin, or cache policy. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
curl -X PATCH "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name": "<name>", "cache_policy": "static-assets"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/update-cdn-distribution

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `distribution_id` (string, required) — CDN distribution ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects an UpdateCdnDistributionRequest.

- `name` (string, optional) — New display name.
- `cache_policy` (enum, optional) — New caching behaviour. - `static-assets`: long-term caching for immutable assets; 1 year at the CDN, browsers revalidate. - `media`: medium-term caching for video and audio; 30 days at the CDN. - `short`: short-term caching for frequently changing content; 1 hour at the CDN. - `no-cache`: no caching, for dynamic responses.
  - Allowed values: `static-assets`, `media`, `short`, `no-cache`
- `enabled` (boolean, optional) — Whether the distribution serves traffic.

## Response

### 200

Distribution updated successfully.

- `id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the distribution.
- `name` (string, required) — Display name of the distribution.
- `origin_type` (enum, required) — - `bucket`: an Object Storage bucket. - `custom`: a custom origin.
  - Allowed values: `bucket`, `custom`
- `origin_id` (string, required) — Bucket name or custom origin ID.
- `cache_policy` (string, required) — Caching behaviour in effect. - `static-assets`: long-term caching for immutable assets; 1 year at the CDN, browsers revalidate. - `media`: medium-term caching for video and audio; 30 days at the CDN. - `short`: short-term caching for frequently changing content; 1 hour at the CDN. - `no-cache`: no caching, for dynamic responses.
- `enabled` (boolean, required) — Whether the distribution serves traffic.
- `status` (enum, required) — - `active`: serving. - `deploying`: configuration is being rolled out to the edge. - `disabled`: turned off. - `failed`: deployment failed. - `deleted`: removed.
  - Allowed values: `active`, `deploying`, `disabled`, `failed`, `deleted`
- `default_domain` (string, required) — Hostname IBEE assigned to the distribution, for example `dl-abc123.cdn.ibee.ai`.
- `default_url` (string, required) — `https://` URL of `default_domain`.
- `custom_domains` (list of string, required) — Custom hostnames attached to the distribution.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the distribution was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the distribution was last changed (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 423 Locked Error

The organization is suspended (`organization_suspended`), so writes are refused.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. - `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`.
```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"net/http"
	"io"
)

func main() {

	url := "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/distribution_123?workspace_id=710995"

	payload := strings.NewReader("{\n  \"name\": \"<name>\",\n  \"cache_policy\": \"static-assets\"\n}")

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("PATCH", url, payload)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}
```

```swift
import Foundation

let headers = [
  "Authorization": "Bearer <token>",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
]
let parameters = [
  "name": "<name>",
  "cache_policy": "static-assets"
] as [String : Any]

let postData = JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: parameters, options: [])

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/distribution_123?workspace_id=710995")! as URL,
                                        cachePolicy: .useProtocolCachePolicy,
                                    timeoutInterval: 10.0)

  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```

# Get static website configuration

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/website-config

Returns a CDN distribution's static website settings, such as its index document. Requires scope: cdn.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/website-config?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/get-cdn-website-config

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `distribution_id` (string, required) — CDN distribution ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

# Enable or update static website configuration

PUT https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/website-config
Content-Type: application/json

Turns on static website hosting for a CDN distribution, or changes its index document. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
curl -X PUT "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/website-config?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"index_document": "index.html"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/update-cdn-website-config

A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. ### 423 Locked Error

```go
package main

import (

func main() {

	url := "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/distribution_123/website-config?workspace_id=710995"

	payload := strings.NewReader("{\n  \"index_document\": \"index.html\"\n}")

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("PUT", url, payload)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}
```

```swift
import Foundation

let headers = [
  "Authorization": "Bearer <token>",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
]
let parameters = ["index_document": "index.html"] as [String : Any]

let postData = JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: parameters, options: [])

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/distribution_123/website-config?workspace_id=710995")! as URL,
                                        cachePolicy: .useProtocolCachePolicy,
                                    timeoutInterval: 10.0)

request.allHTTPHeaderFields = headers
request.httpBody = postData as Data

let session = URLSession.shared
let dataTask = session.dataTask(with: request as URLRequest, completionHandler: { (data, response, error) -> Void in
  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```

# Disable static website configuration

DELETE https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/website-config

Turns off static website hosting for a CDN distribution. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
curl -X DELETE "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/website-config?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/delete-cdn-website-config

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `distribution_id` (string, required) — CDN distribution ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Website configuration disabled successfully.

- `distribution_id` (string, required) — ID of the distribution.
- `enabled` (boolean, required) — Whether static-website serving is on.
- `index_document` (string, required, default: index.html) — Object served for directory requests.
- `created_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the settings were created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, optional, nullable) — When the settings were last changed (ISO 8601).

# List CDN custom domains

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/custom-domains

Lists the custom domains on a CDN distribution, with their verification and certificate status. Requires scope: cdn.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/custom-domains?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```

On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### CdnCustomDomain

A custom hostname on a distribution.

- `domain` (string, required) — The hostname.
- `status` (enum, required) — - `pending_validation`: waiting for the DNS CNAME to be detected. - `pending_tls`: validated; the certificate is being issued. - `active`: certificate issued; the domain serves traffic. - `failed`: validation or certificate issuance failed.

title: Add CDN custom domain

# Add CDN custom domain

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/custom-domains
Content-Type: application/json

Adds a custom domain to a CDN distribution and returns the DNS records needed to verify it. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/custom-domains?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"domain": "<domain>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/create-cdn-custom-domain

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `distribution_id` (string, required) — CDN distribution ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a CreateCdnCustomDomainRequest.

- `domain` (string, required) — Fully qualified hostname to serve, for example `cdn.example.com`.

## Response

### 201

Custom domain added successfully.

- `domain` (string, required) — The hostname.
- `status` (enum, required) — - `pending_validation`: waiting for the DNS CNAME to be detected. - `pending_tls`: validated; the certificate is being issued. - `active`: certificate issued; the domain serves traffic. - `failed`: validation or certificate issuance failed.
  - Allowed values: `pending_validation`, `pending_tls`, `active`, `failed`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the hostname was added (ISO 8601).
- `tls_status` (string, optional, nullable) — Certificate status reported by the edge provider, when available.
- `instructions` (list of string, optional, nullable) — Steps to complete setup, such as the CNAME record to create.

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

```swift
let headers = [
  "Authorization": "Bearer <token>",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
]
let parameters = ["domain": "<domain>"] as [String : Any]

let postData = JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: parameters, options: [])

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/distribution_123/custom-domains?workspace_id=710995")! as URL,
                                        cachePolicy: .useProtocolCachePolicy,
                                    timeoutInterval: 10.0)
request.httpMethod = "POST"
request.allHTTPHeaderFields = headers
request.httpBody = postData as Data

let session = URLSession.shared
let dataTask = session.dataTask(with: request as URLRequest, completionHandler: { (data, response, error) -> Void in
  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```

# Get CDN custom domain

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/custom-domains/{domain}

Returns a CDN custom domain's verification status, DNS instructions, and TLS certificate status. Requires scope: cdn.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
# DOMAIN: Fully qualified custom domain
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/custom-domains/$DOMAIN?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/get-cdn-custom-domain

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `distribution_id` (string, required) — CDN distribution ID.
- `domain` (string, required) — Fully qualified custom domain.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Custom domain returned successfully.

- `domain` (string, required) — The hostname.
- `status` (enum, required) — - `pending_validation`: waiting for the DNS CNAME to be detected. - `pending_tls`: validated; the certificate is being issued. - `active`: certificate issued; the domain serves traffic. - `failed`: validation or certificate issuance failed.
  - Allowed values: `pending_validation`, `pending_tls`, `active`, `failed`
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the hostname was added (ISO 8601).
- `tls_status` (string, optional, nullable) — Certificate status reported by the edge provider, when available.
- `instructions` (list of string, optional, nullable) — Steps to complete setup, such as the CNAME record to create.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

# Remove CDN custom domain

DELETE https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/custom-domains/{domain}

Removes a custom domain from a CDN distribution. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
# DOMAIN: Fully qualified custom domain
curl -X DELETE "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/custom-domains/$DOMAIN?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```

# Verify CDN custom domain

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/custom-domains/{domain}/verify

Checks a CDN custom domain's DNS records and updates its verification status. Requires scope: cdn.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
# DOMAIN: Fully qualified custom domain
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/custom-domains/$DOMAIN/verify?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/verify-cdn-custom-domain

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `distribution_id` (string, required) — CDN distribution ID.
- `domain` (string, required) — Fully qualified custom domain.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Domain verification completed.

- `domain` (string, required) — The hostname.
- `status` (enum, required) — - `pending_validation`: waiting for the DNS CNAME to be detected. - `pending_tls`: validated; the certificate is being issued. - `active`: certificate issued; the domain serves traffic. - `failed`: validation or certificate issuance failed.
  - Allowed values: `pending_validation`, `pending_tls`, `active`, `failed`
- `message` (string, required) — Human-readable result.
- `tls_status` (string, optional, nullable) — Certificate status reported by the edge provider, when available.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. ---
title: Purge CDN cache
url: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/purge-cdn-cache
---

# Purge CDN cache

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/{distribution_id}/purge
Content-Type: application/json

Purges matching cache content synchronously for a distribution in the
selected workspace. For a normal single-page application deployment,
use `mode: url` with `paths: ["/index.html"]`. Do not purge
fingerprinted assets such as `/assets/app.a91c3.js`; use `paths: ["/*"]` only for an emergency full-cache invalidation.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# DISTRIBUTION_ID: CDN distribution ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/$DISTRIBUTION_ID/purge?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"mode": "url"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/cdn/purge-cdn-cache

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `distribution_id` (string, required) — CDN distribution ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a PurgeCdnCacheRequest.

- `mode` (enum, required) — - `url`: purge the paths in `paths`. - `hostname`: purge everything for the hostnames in `hostnames`. - `tag`: purge content tagged with `tags`. - `prefix`: purge paths starting with `prefixes`. - `all`: purge the whole distribution.
  - Allowed values: `url`, `hostname`, `tag`, `prefix`, `all`
- `paths` (list of string, optional) — Paths to purge, for `url` mode.
- `hostnames` (list of string, optional) — Hostnames to purge, for `hostname` mode.
- `tags` (list of string, optional) — Cache tags to purge, for `tag` mode.
- `prefixes` (list of string, optional) — Path prefixes to purge, for `prefix` mode.

## Response

### 200

Cache purge completed.

- `success` (boolean, required) — True when the purge was accepted.
- `mode` (enum, required) — Purge mode that was applied. - `url` - `hostname` - `tag` - `prefix` - `all`
  - Allowed values: `url`, `hostname`, `tag`, `prefix`, `all`
- `purged` (list of string, optional, nullable) — Items that were purged, when the mode lists them.
- `message` (string, optional, nullable) — Human-readable result.

Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

```swift
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
]
let parameters = ["mode": "url"] as [String : Any]

let postData = JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: parameters, options: [])

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/cdn/distributions/distribution_123/purge?workspace_id=710995")! as URL,
                                        cachePolicy: .useProtocolCachePolicy,
                                    timeoutInterval: 10.0)
request.httpMethod = "POST"
request.allHTTPHeaderFields = headers
request.httpBody = postData as Data

let session = URLSession.shared
let dataTask = session.dataTask(with: request as URLRequest, completionHandler: { (data, response, error) -> Void in
  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```

# Check registry name availability

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registry-names/{registry_name}/availability

Checks whether a registry name is free across IBEE. Names are global and never reassigned; unavailable names come with suggestions. Requires scope: container-registry.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_NAME: Registry name to check
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registry-names/$REGISTRY_NAME/availability?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/check-container-registry-name-availability

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_name` (string, required) — Registry name to check.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Availability returned.

- `registry_name` (string, required) — Name that was checked.
- `available` (boolean, required) — True when the name is free.
- `suggestions` (list of string, required) — Free names close to the requested one, when it is taken.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 422 Unprocessable Entity Error

The registry service rejected a parameter or the body (`detail` lists the invalid fields), or the selected storage plan is not sold here (`detail.code`, for example `billing_sku_unavailable` or `billing_selection_not_found`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

# List registries

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries

Lists the workspace's registries, newest first. Paged with `page` and `page_size` (at most 100). Requires scope: container-registry.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/list-container-registries

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.
- `page` (integer, optional, default: 1) — Page number.
- `page_size` (integer, optional, default: 20) — Number of records per page.

## Response

### 200

Registries returned.

- `items` (list of ContainerRegistry, required) — Registries on this page.
- `total` (integer, required) — Total number of items matching the request.
- `page` (integer, required) — Page number returned (1-based).
- `page_size` (integer, required) — Page size that was applied.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 422 Unprocessable Entity Error

The registry service rejected a parameter or the body (`detail` lists the invalid fields), or the selected storage plan is not sold here (`detail.code`, for example `billing_sku_unavailable` or `billing_selection_not_found`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. - `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### ContainerRegistry

A container registry. Images are pushed to and pulled from `registry.ibee.ai/<registry_name>/<repository>:<tag>`.

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the registry.
- `registry_name` (string, required) — Registry name. Images live at `registry.ibee.ai/<registry_name>/<repository>:<tag>`.
- `registry_kind` (enum, required) — Always `CUSTOMER` for registries created through the API.
  - Allowed values: `CUSTOMER`
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `visibility` (enum, required) — `PRIVATE` registries need a registry access token to pull. `PUBLIC` registries allow anonymous pulls, whose outbound bandwidth is billed to the workspace. Pushing always needs a token with push permission.
  - Allowed values: `PRIVATE`, `PUBLIC`
- `security` (ContainerRegistrySecuritySettings, required) — Security settings of a registry.
- `desired_state` (enum, required) — State requested by the caller. - `ACTIVE` - `DELETED`
  - Allowed values: `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`
- `observed_state` (enum, required) — State the registry service has actually reached. - `PROVISIONING`: being created. - `UPDATING`: a change is being applied. - `DELETING`: being removed. - `ACTIVE`: ready. - `ERROR`: the last change failed. - `DELETED`: removed.
  - Allowed values: `PROVISIONING`, `UPDATING`, `DELETING`, `ACTIVE`, `ERROR`, `DELETED`
- `generation` (integer, required) — Incremented by every accepted change.
- `observed_generation` (integer, required) — The last generation applied; equal to `generation` when settled.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `deleted_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When deletion was requested (ISO 8601); null while the registry exists.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

### ContainerRegistrySecuritySettings

Security settings of a registry.

- `vulnerability_pull_policy` (enum, optional) — `ALLOW` pulls every image. `BLOCK_<SEVERITY>` refuses pulls of images with a finding at or above that severity.
  - Allowed values: `ALLOW`, `BLOCK_CRITICAL`, `BLOCK_HIGH`, `BLOCK_MEDIUM`, `BLOCK_LOW`

```json
      "organization_id": "<organization_id>",

        "vulnerability_pull_policy": "ALLOW"
```
