# Create registry

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries
Content-Type: application/json

Creates a registry with a storage plan (`billing_catalog.sku_code`).
The registry service asks Billing whether the workspace may buy that
plan and refuses with 403 `billing_resource_not_eligible` (and a
`reason`) when it may not. Returns 201 when the registry is active, or
202 while provisioning finishes in the background; poll the registry
until `observed_state` is `ACTIVE`. Requires scope:
container-registry.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"registry_name": "<registry_name>", "confirm_registry_name": "<confirm_registry_name>", "billing_catalog": {"sku_code": "<sku_code>"}}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/create-container-registry

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a CreateContainerRegistryRequest.

- `registry_name` (string, required) — Globally unique name; it cannot be changed or reused.
- `confirm_registry_name` (string, required) — Must equal `registry_name`.
- `billing_catalog` (ContainerRegistryBillingCatalog, required) — The storage plan to bill the registry against, identified by SKU.
- `visibility` (enum, optional, default: PRIVATE) — - `PRIVATE`: pulls need an access token (default). - `PUBLIC`: anonymous pulls are allowed; egress is charged.
  - Allowed values: `PRIVATE`, `PUBLIC`
- `acknowledge_public_egress_charges` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Required to be `true` when `visibility` is `PUBLIC`.
- `security` (ContainerRegistrySecuritySettings, optional) — Security settings of a registry.

## Response

### 201

Registry created and active.

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the registry.
- `registry_name` (string, required) — Registry name. Images live at `registry.ibee.ai/<registry_name>/<repository>:<tag>`.
- `registry_kind` (enum, required) — Always `CUSTOMER` for registries created through the API.
  - Allowed values: `CUSTOMER`
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `visibility` (enum, required) — `PRIVATE` registries need a registry access token to pull. `PUBLIC` registries allow anonymous pulls, whose outbound bandwidth is billed to the workspace. Pushing always needs a token with push permission.
  - Allowed values: `PRIVATE`, `PUBLIC`
- `security` (ContainerRegistrySecuritySettings, required) — Security settings of a registry.
- `desired_state` (enum, required) — State requested by the caller. - `ACTIVE` - `DELETED`
  - Allowed values: `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`
- `observed_state` (enum, required) — State the registry service has actually reached. - `PROVISIONING`: being created. - `UPDATING`: a change is being applied. - `DELETING`: being removed. - `ACTIVE`: ready. - `ERROR`: the last change failed. - `DELETED`: removed.
  - Allowed values: `PROVISIONING`, `UPDATING`, `DELETING`, `ACTIVE`, `ERROR`, `DELETED`
- `generation` (integer, required) — Incremented by every accepted change.
- `observed_generation` (integer, required) — The last generation applied; equal to `generation` when settled.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `deleted_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When deletion was requested (ISO 8601); null while the registry exists.

### 202

Registry accepted; provisioning continues in the background.

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the registry.
- `registry_name` (string, required) — Registry name. Images live at `registry.ibee.ai/<registry_name>/<repository>:<tag>`.
- `registry_kind` (enum, required) — Always `CUSTOMER` for registries created through the API.
  - Allowed values: `CUSTOMER`
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `visibility` (enum, required) — `PRIVATE` registries need a registry access token to pull. `PUBLIC` registries allow anonymous pulls, whose outbound bandwidth is billed to the workspace. Pushing always needs a token with push permission.
  - Allowed values: `PRIVATE`, `PUBLIC`
- `security` (ContainerRegistrySecuritySettings, required) — Security settings of a registry.
- `desired_state` (enum, required) — State requested by the caller. - `ACTIVE` - `DELETED`
  - Allowed values: `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`
- `observed_state` (enum, required) — State the registry service has actually reached. - `PROVISIONING`: being created. - `UPDATING`: a change is being applied. - `DELETING`: being removed. - `ACTIVE`: ready. - `ERROR`: the last change failed. - `DELETED`: removed.
  - Allowed values: `PROVISIONING`, `UPDATING`, `DELETING`, `ACTIVE`, `ERROR`, `DELETED`
- `generation` (integer, required) — Incremented by every accepted change.
- `observed_generation` (integer, required) — The last generation applied; equal to `generation` when settled.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `deleted_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When deletion was requested (ISO 8601); null while the registry exists.

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 409 Conflict Error

The request conflicts with the current resource state.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 422 Unprocessable Entity Error

The registry service rejected a parameter or the body (`detail` lists the invalid fields), or the selected storage plan is not sold here (`detail.code`, for example `billing_sku_unavailable` or `billing_selection_not_found`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### ContainerRegistryBillingCatalog

The storage plan to bill the registry against, identified by SKU.

- `sku_code` (string, required) — Storage plan SKU, for example `REGISTRY-STORAGE-250GB`. The service trims and upper-cases it, then requires `^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9_.-]*$`. Capacity and price come from Billing.

### ContainerRegistrySecuritySettings

Security settings of a registry.

- `vulnerability_pull_policy` (enum, optional) — `ALLOW` pulls every image. `BLOCK_<SEVERITY>` refuses pulls of images with a finding at or above that severity.
  - Allowed values: `ALLOW`, `BLOCK_CRITICAL`, `BLOCK_HIGH`, `BLOCK_MEDIUM`, `BLOCK_LOW`

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

import (

func main() {

	url := "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries?workspace_id=710995"

	payload := strings.NewReader("{\n  \"registry_name\": \"<registry_name>\",\n  \"confirm_registry_name\": \"<confirm_registry_name>\",\n  \"billing_catalog\": {\n    \"sku_code\": \"<sku_code>\"\n  }\n}")

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, payload)

	req.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer <token>")
	req.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")

	res, _ := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)

	defer res.Body.Close()
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)

	fmt.Println(res)
	fmt.Println(string(body))

}

```swift
import Foundation

let headers = [
  "Authorization": "Bearer <token>",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
]
let parameters = [
  "registry_name": "<registry_name>",
  "confirm_registry_name": "<confirm_registry_name>",
  "billing_catalog": ["sku_code": "<sku_code>"]
] as [String : Any]

let postData = JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: parameters, options: [])

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries?workspace_id=710995")! as URL,
                                        cachePolicy: .useProtocolCachePolicy,
                                    timeoutInterval: 10.0)
request.httpMethod = "POST"
request.allHTTPHeaderFields = headers
request.httpBody = postData as Data

let session = URLSession.shared
let dataTask = session.dataTask(with: request as URLRequest, completionHandler: { (data, response, error) -> Void in
  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```

# Get registry

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}

Returns one registry, including its visibility, pull policy and provisioning state. A deleted registry is still returned, with `deleted_at` set. Requires scope: container-registry.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/get-container-registry

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 422 Unprocessable Entity Error

The registry service rejected a parameter or the body (`detail` lists the invalid fields), or the selected storage plan is not sold here (`detail.code`, for example `billing_sku_unavailable` or `billing_selection_not_found`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

- `vulnerability_pull_policy` (enum, optional) — `ALLOW` pulls every image. `BLOCK_<SEVERITY>` refuses pulls of images with a finding at or above that severity.
  - Allowed values: `ALLOW`, `BLOCK_CRITICAL`, `BLOCK_HIGH`, `BLOCK_MEDIUM`, `BLOCK_LOW`

---
title: Delete registry
url: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/delete-container-registry
---

# Delete registry

DELETE https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}

Starts deleting a registry; returns 202 with `observed_state: DELETING`. The registry must be empty: 409 with `detail.code: registry_not_empty` otherwise (see Empty registry). The name is never reused. Requires scope: container-registry.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl -X DELETE "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID&confirm_registry_name=<confirm_registry_name>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/delete-container-registry

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Registry ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.
- `confirm_registry_name` (string, required) — The registry's name, repeated to confirm a destructive call.

## Response

### 202

Deletion accepted.

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the registry.
- `registry_name` (string, required) — Registry name. Images live at `registry.ibee.ai/<registry_name>/<repository>:<tag>`.
- `registry_kind` (enum, required) — Always `CUSTOMER` for registries created through the API.
  - Allowed values: `CUSTOMER`
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `visibility` (enum, required) — `PRIVATE` registries need a registry access token to pull. `PUBLIC` registries allow anonymous pulls, whose outbound bandwidth is billed to the workspace. Pushing always needs a token with push permission.
  - Allowed values: `PRIVATE`, `PUBLIC`
- `security` (ContainerRegistrySecuritySettings, required) — Security settings of a registry.
- `desired_state` (enum, required) — State requested by the caller. - `ACTIVE` - `DELETED`
  - Allowed values: `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`
- `observed_state` (enum, required) — State the registry service has actually reached. - `PROVISIONING`: being created. - `UPDATING`: a change is being applied. - `DELETING`: being removed. - `ACTIVE`: ready. - `ERROR`: the last change failed. - `DELETED`: removed.
  - Allowed values: `PROVISIONING`, `UPDATING`, `DELETING`, `ACTIVE`, `ERROR`, `DELETED`
- `generation` (integer, required) — Incremented by every accepted change.
- `observed_generation` (integer, required) — The last generation applied; equal to `generation` when settled.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `deleted_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When deletion was requested (ISO 8601); null while the registry exists.

## Errors

From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.

title: Change registry visibility

# Change registry visibility

PATCH https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}/visibility
Content-Type: application/json

Makes a registry private or public. Public requires `acknowledge_public_egress_charges: true`, because anonymous pull bandwidth is billed to the workspace. Returns 202 while the change is applied. Requires scope: container-registry.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl -X PATCH "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID/visibility?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"visibility": "PRIVATE"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/update-container-registry-visibility

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Registry ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects an UpdateContainerRegistryVisibilityRequest.

- `visibility` (enum, required) — `PRIVATE` registries need a registry access token to pull. `PUBLIC` registries allow anonymous pulls, whose outbound bandwidth is billed to the workspace. Pushing always needs a token with push permission.
  - Allowed values: `PRIVATE`, `PUBLIC`
- `acknowledge_public_egress_charges` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Required to be `true` when `visibility` is `PUBLIC`.

## Response

### 202

Visibility change accepted.

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the registry.
- `registry_name` (string, required) — Registry name. Images live at `registry.ibee.ai/<registry_name>/<repository>:<tag>`.
- `registry_kind` (enum, required) — Always `CUSTOMER` for registries created through the API.
  - Allowed values: `CUSTOMER`
- `organization_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning organization.
- `workspace_id` (string, required) — ID of the owning workspace.
- `visibility` (enum, required) — `PRIVATE` registries need a registry access token to pull. `PUBLIC` registries allow anonymous pulls, whose outbound bandwidth is billed to the workspace. Pushing always needs a token with push permission.
  - Allowed values: `PRIVATE`, `PUBLIC`
- `security` (ContainerRegistrySecuritySettings, required) — Security settings of a registry.
- `desired_state` (enum, required) — State requested by the caller. - `ACTIVE` - `DELETED`
  - Allowed values: `ACTIVE`, `DELETED`
- `observed_state` (enum, required) — State the registry service has actually reached. - `PROVISIONING`: being created. - `UPDATING`: a change is being applied. - `DELETING`: being removed. - `ACTIVE`: ready. - `ERROR`: the last change failed. - `DELETED`: removed.
  - Allowed values: `PROVISIONING`, `UPDATING`, `DELETING`, `ACTIVE`, `ERROR`, `DELETED`
- `generation` (integer, required) — Incremented by every accepted change.
- `observed_generation` (integer, required) — The last generation applied; equal to `generation` when settled.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was created (ISO 8601).
- `updated_at` (datetime, required) — When the registry was last changed (ISO 8601).
- `deleted_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When deletion was requested (ISO 8601); null while the registry exists.

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. # Retry registry provisioning

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}/reconcile

Queues the registry's pending change (create, update, upgrade or delete) to run again, for example after `observed_state: ERROR`. Requires scope: container-registry.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID/reconcile?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/retry-container-registry-provisioning

Retry queued.

- `registry_id` (string, required) — ID of the registry.
- `generation` (integer, required) — Generation the reconcile will apply.
- `status` (enum, required) — Status of a reconcile job. - `PENDING`: queued. - `PROCESSING`: running. - `COMPLETE`: finished. - `FAILED`: finished with an error.
  - Allowed values: `PENDING`, `PROCESSING`, `COMPLETE`, `FAILED`

- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 422 Unprocessable Entity Error

The registry service rejected a parameter or the body (`detail` lists the invalid fields), or the selected storage plan is not sold here (`detail.code`, for example `billing_sku_unavailable` or `billing_selection_not_found`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

# Empty registry

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}/empty

Permanently deletes every repository and image in a registry, so it can be deleted. A bounded run can stop early with 409 `detail.code: registry_empty_incomplete` (`retryable: true`); pause pushes and call again. Requires scope: container-registry.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID/empty?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID&confirm_registry_name=<confirm_registry_name>" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/empty-container-registry

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Registry ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.
- `confirm_registry_name` (string, required) — The registry's name, repeated to confirm a destructive call.

## Response

### 200

Registry emptied.

- `registry_id` (string, required) — ID of the registry.
- `registry_name` (string, required) — Name of the registry.
- `deleted_repository_count` (integer, required) — Number of repositories that were deleted.

## Errors

### 400 Bad Request Error

The request is invalid. From the gateway: `workspace_id_required` or `invalid_workspace_id`; on billable creates also `invalid_json_body` and selection codes such as `plan_id_required`, `invalid_site_id`, `compute_billing_term_required` or `invalid_block_storage_selection`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

# Get registry storage plan

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}/package

Returns the registry's current storage plan, a pending upgrade if there is one, and the status of the change being applied. Requires scope: container-registry.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID/package?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/get-container-registry-package

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Registry ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Plan returned.

- `registry_id` (string, required) — ID of the registry.
- `current` (ContainerRegistryPackageAssignment, required, nullable) — The plan in effect.
- `pending` (ContainerRegistryPackageOperation, required, nullable) — A plan change that has not been applied yet.
- `reconciliation_status` (enum, required, nullable) — Status of the job applying the pending change, when one is running.
  - Allowed values: `PENDING`, `PROCESSING`, `COMPLETE`, `FAILED`

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.

## Types

### ContainerRegistryPackageAssignment

A storage plan assigned to the registry for a period.

- `assignment_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the assignment.
- `sku_id` (string, required) — Billing catalog SKU ID of the plan.
- `sku_code` (string, required) — Storage plan SKU code.
- `quota_bytes` (integer, required) — Storage quota of the plan in bytes (decimal GB).
- `quota_gb` (double, required) — Decimal GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes).
- `effective_from` (datetime, required) — When the plan took effect (ISO 8601).
- `effective_to` (datetime, required, nullable) — When the plan stopped applying (ISO 8601); null while current.

### ContainerRegistryPackageOperation

A plan change requested for the registry.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the operation.
- `registry_id` (string, required) — ID of the registry.
- `kind` (enum, required) — - `CREATE`: the plan chosen at registry creation. - `UPGRADE`: a move to a larger plan.
  - Allowed values: `CREATE`, `UPGRADE`
- `status` (enum, required) — - `PENDING`: not applied yet. - `APPLIED`: in effect. - `CANCELLED`: withdrawn before it was applied.
  - Allowed values: `PENDING`, `APPLIED`, `CANCELLED`
- `sku_code` (string, required) — Storage plan SKU code.
- `quota_bytes` (integer, required) — Storage quota of the plan in bytes (decimal GB).
- `quota_gb` (double, required) — Decimal GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes).
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was requested (ISO 8601).
- `effective_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When the operation took or will take effect (ISO 8601); null when not yet scheduled.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

---
title: Upgrade registry storage plan
url: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/upgrade-container-registry-package

# Upgrade registry storage plan

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}/upgrade
Content-Type: application/json

Moves an active registry to a larger storage plan. Only larger quotas
are accepted and only one change can be pending (409 otherwise). The
registry service asks Billing first and refuses with 403
`billing_resource_not_eligible` when the plan is not allowed. Send an
`Idempotency-Key` header: a retry with the same key and plan returns
the original operation (202 while pending, 200 once applied); the same
key with a different plan returns 409. Requires scope:
container-registry.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID/upgrade?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"billing_catalog": {"sku_code": "<sku_code>"}}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/upgrade-container-registry-package

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Registry ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Headers

- `Idempotency-Key` (string, required) — Unique key for this upgrade. The registry service reads this header (not `X-Idempotency-Key`); a retry with the same key and plan returns the original operation.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects an UpgradeContainerRegistryPackageRequest.

- `billing_catalog` (ContainerRegistryBillingCatalog, required) — The storage plan to bill the registry against, identified by SKU.

## Response

### 200

Replay of an upgrade that has already been applied.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the operation.
- `registry_id` (string, required) — ID of the registry.
- `kind` (enum, required) — - `CREATE`: the plan chosen at registry creation. - `UPGRADE`: a move to a larger plan.
  - Allowed values: `CREATE`, `UPGRADE`
- `status` (enum, required) — - `PENDING`: not applied yet. - `APPLIED`: in effect. - `CANCELLED`: withdrawn before it was applied.
  - Allowed values: `PENDING`, `APPLIED`, `CANCELLED`
- `sku_code` (string, required) — Storage plan SKU code.
- `quota_bytes` (integer, required) — Storage quota of the plan in bytes (decimal GB).
- `quota_gb` (double, required) — Decimal GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes).
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was requested (ISO 8601).
- `effective_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When the operation took or will take effect (ISO 8601); null when not yet scheduled.

### 202

Upgrade accepted and pending.

- `operation_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the operation.
- `registry_id` (string, required) — ID of the registry.
- `kind` (enum, required) — - `CREATE`: the plan chosen at registry creation. - `UPGRADE`: a move to a larger plan.
  - Allowed values: `CREATE`, `UPGRADE`
- `status` (enum, required) — - `PENDING`: not applied yet. - `APPLIED`: in effect. - `CANCELLED`: withdrawn before it was applied.
  - Allowed values: `PENDING`, `APPLIED`, `CANCELLED`
- `sku_code` (string, required) — Storage plan SKU code.
- `quota_bytes` (integer, required) — Storage quota of the plan in bytes (decimal GB).
- `quota_gb` (double, required) — Decimal GB (1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes).
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the operation was requested (ISO 8601).
- `effective_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When the operation took or will take effect (ISO 8601); null when not yet scheduled.

The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

# List registry access tokens

GET https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}/access-tokens

Lists the access tokens that can use this registry, newest first. Secrets are never returned. Requires scope: container-registry.read.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID/access-tokens?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/list-container-registry-access-tokens

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Registry ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.
- `include_revoked` (boolean, optional, default: false) — Include revoked tokens.

## Response

### 200

Tokens returned.

- `list of ContainerRegistryAccessToken`

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 404 Not Found Error

The requested resource was not found.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 422 Unprocessable Entity Error

The registry service rejected a parameter or the body (`detail` lists the invalid fields), or the selected storage plan is not sold here (`detail.code`, for example `billing_sku_unavailable` or `billing_selection_not_found`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

## Types

### ContainerRegistryAccessToken

A registry access token without its secret.

- `token_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the token.
- `token_name` (string, required) — Name of the token.
- `harbor_username` (string, required) — Docker login username (the `username` returned at creation).
- `permission` (enum, required) — What a registry access token may do. - `PULL`: pull images. - `PULL_PUSH`: pull and push images.
  - Allowed values: `PULL`, `PULL_PUSH`
- `registry_ids` (list of string, required) — Registries the token may use.
- `disabled` (boolean, required) — True when the token has been revoked or disabled and no longer authenticates.
- `expires_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When the token expires (ISO 8601); null for a token that does not expire.
- `created_by_user_id` (string, required, nullable) — User who created the token, when it was created by a user.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the token was created (ISO 8601).
- `revoked_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When the token was revoked (ISO 8601); null while valid.

### ErrorDetail

Error detail from the product service.

- string
- map from string to any
- list of any

# Create registry access token

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}/access-tokens
Content-Type: application/json

Creates a Docker login credential for the registry. The `username`
and `secret` are returned once and cannot be read again. The registry
must be active, and the registry service asks Billing whether the
workspace may create credentials. Requires scope:
container-registry.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID/access-tokens?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"token_name": "<token_name>"}'
```

Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/create-container-registry-access-token

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Registry ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

### Body (application/json)

This endpoint expects a CreateContainerRegistryAccessTokenRequest.

- `token_name` (string, required) — Unique among the organization's active tokens.
- `permission` (enum, optional, default: PULL) — - `PULL`: pull only (default). - `PULL_PUSH`: pull and push.
  - Allowed values: `PULL`, `PULL_PUSH`
- `expires_in_days` (integer, optional, default: 90) — 1 to 365, or -1 for a token that does not expire.
- `description` (string, optional, default: ) — Optional description (up to 255 characters).
- `registry_ids` (list of string, optional) — Other registries in the same workspace the token may also use. The registry in the path is always included.

## Response

### 201

Token created. Store the secret now.

- `token_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the token.
- `token_name` (string, required) — Name of the token.
- `username` (string, required) — Docker login username. It contains `$`, so quote it in shells.
- `secret` (string, required) — Docker login password. Returned only by create and rotate.
- `permission` (enum, required) — What a registry access token may do. - `PULL`: pull images. - `PULL_PUSH`: pull and push images.
  - Allowed values: `PULL`, `PULL_PUSH`
- `registry_ids` (list of string, required) — Registries the token may use.
- `expires_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When the token expires (ISO 8601); null for a token that does not expire.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the token was created (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. - `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 409 Conflict Error

The request conflicts with the current resource state.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.

- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 422 Unprocessable Entity Error

The registry service rejected a parameter or the body (`detail` lists the invalid fields), or the selected storage plan is not sold here (`detail.code`, for example `billing_sku_unavailable` or `billing_selection_not_found`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.

- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 503 Service Unavailable Error

A service the request depends on did not answer. Gateway codes: `workspace_verification_unavailable`, `principal_verification_unavailable` and `principal_authorization_unavailable`; on billable creates also `billing_admission_timeout`, `billing_admission_unavailable`, `billing_admission_disabled`, `billing_admission_not_configured` and the catalog codes `compute_catalog_unavailable`, `compute_catalog_not_configured`, `product_catalog_timeout`, `product_catalog_unavailable`, `product_catalog_not_configured` and `unsupported_product_quote`. Otherwise the product service's `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.

```swift
import Foundation

let headers = [
  "Authorization": "Bearer <token>",
  "Content-Type": "application/json"
]
let parameters = ["token_name": "<token_name>"] as [String : Any]

let postData = JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: parameters, options: [])

let request = NSMutableURLRequest(url: NSURL(string: "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/registry_123/access-tokens?workspace_id=710995")! as URL,
                                        cachePolicy: .useProtocolCachePolicy,
                                    timeoutInterval: 10.0)

request.allHTTPHeaderFields = headers
request.httpBody = postData as Data

let session = URLSession.shared
let dataTask = session.dataTask(with: request as URLRequest, completionHandler: { (data, response, error) -> Void in
  if (error != nil) {
    print(error as Any)
  } else {
    let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse
    print(httpResponse)
  }
})

dataTask.resume()
```

# Rotate registry access token

POST https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/{registry_id}/access-tokens/{token_id}/rotate

Issues a new secret for an active token; the old secret stops working immediately. The new secret is returned once. Revoked or expired tokens return 409. Requires scope: container-registry.write.

```
# Example request with curl (set IBEE_API_TOKEN to a platform API token and WORKSPACE_ID to the workspace first).
# REGISTRY_ID: Registry ID
# TOKEN_ID: Registry access token ID
curl -X POST "https://api.ibee.ai/v1/container-registry/registries/$REGISTRY_ID/access-tokens/$TOKEN_ID/rotate?workspace_id=$WORKSPACE_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $IBEE_API_TOKEN"
```


Reference: https://ibee.ai/docs/api-reference/container-registry/rotate-container-registry-access-token

## Authentication

- `Authorization` header (bearer token, required) — IBEE platform API token. Production tokens start with `ibee_prod_key_`; development tokens start with `ibee_dev_key_`. Use a token only with its matching gateway environment.

## Servers

- `https://api.ibee.ai/v1` (Production, default)
- `https://api.ibee.co.in/v1` (Development)

## Request

### Path parameters

- `registry_id` (string, required) — Registry ID.
- `token_id` (string, required) — Registry access token ID.

### Query parameters

- `workspace_id` (string, required) — The positive numeric workspace ID to scope this request to. Zero, negative, and non-numeric values are rejected.

## Response

### 200

Secret rotated. Store the new secret now.

- `token_id` (string, required) — Unique ID of the token.
- `token_name` (string, required) — Name of the token.
- `username` (string, required) — Docker login username. It contains `$`, so quote it in shells.
- `secret` (string, required) — Docker login password. Returned only by create and rotate.
- `permission` (enum, required) — What a registry access token may do. - `PULL`: pull images. - `PULL_PUSH`: pull and push images.
  - Allowed values: `PULL`, `PULL_PUSH`
- `registry_ids` (list of string, required) — Registries the token may use.
- `expires_at` (datetime, required, nullable) — When the token expires (ISO 8601); null for a token that does not expire.
- `created_at` (datetime, required) — When the token was created (ISO 8601).

## Errors

### 401 Unauthorized Error

The API token is missing, malformed or unknown (`invalid_api_key`).

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
- `detail` (ErrorDetail, optional) — Error detail from the product service.

### 403 Forbidden Error

The token may not make this call. Gateway codes: `insufficient_scope` (with `required_scope`), `key_revoked`, `key_disabled`, `key_inactive`, `key_expired`, `unknown_route`, `workspace_not_allowed`, `principal_inactive`, `principal_not_member` and `principal_permission_denied`. On writes, also `organization_restricted` (an admin restricted the organization) and `verification_required` (the token's user has not completed identity verification). A product service may also refuse with `detail`.

- `error` (string, optional, nullable) — Machine-readable code from the gateway's authorization step, for example `invalid_api_key`, `insufficient_scope`, `organization_restricted`, `organization_suspended`, `verification_required` or `billing_denied`. The response descriptions list the codes for each status.
- `required_scope` (string, optional, nullable) — The scope the token lacks, with `insufficient_scope`.
- `billing_reason` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing's reason with `billing_denied`, passed through unchanged: for example `insufficient_balance`, `credit_limit_exceeded`, `initial_topup_required`, `resource_limit_reached` or `resource_usage_unavailable`.
- `billing_sku_code` (string, optional, nullable) — The SKU the billing admission checked, when there was one.
- `billing_evaluated_at` (string, optional, nullable) — When Billing made the decision, as Billing returned it.
- `admission_context_id` (string, optional, nullable) — Billing admission context for this request, derived from the token, workspace, route and `X-Idempotency-Key`, so a retry with the same key gets the same id.
